```bash
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /businesses/{business_id}/invites/assets/access`

Assign asset permissions information to an existing invite/request. Can be used to:
- Request access to a partner's asset. Note: This is only for when no existing partnership exists. If an existing
  partnership exists, use "Create a request to access an existing partner's assets" to request access to your
  partner's assets.
    - invite_type="PARTNER_REQUEST"
- Invite a partner to access your business assets. Note: This is only for when there is no existing partnership.
  If there is an existing partnership, use "Assign/Update partner asset permissions" to assign a partner access to
  new assets.
    - invite_type="PARTNER_INVITE"
- Invite a member to access your business assets. Note: This is only for when there is no existing membership.
  If there is an existing membership, use "Assign/Update member asset permissions" to assign a member access to new
  assets.
    - invite_type="MEMBER_INVITE"

To learn more about permission levels, visit https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/business-manager-overview.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "invites": [
    {
      "asset_id_to_permissions": {
        "549760723247": [
          "ANALYST"
        ],
        "549760723248": [
          "ANALYST",
          "ADMIN"
        ],
        "809944451643622187": [
          "PROFILE_PUBLISHER"
        ]
      },
      "invite_id": "1234567890123",
      "invite_type": "MEMBER_INVITE"

}
```

- An [asset group](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/asset-groups) is a custom group of assets based on how you would like to manage your accounts.

```json
    "asset_group_types": [
      "LOCATION_OR_LANGUAGE"
    ],
    "catalogs_ids": [

    ],

}
```

## List business assets

<a id="opIdbusiness_assets/get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.pinterest.com/v5/businesses/string/assets \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /businesses/{business_id}/assets`

Get all the assets the requesting business has access to. This includes assets the business owns and assets the business has access to through partnerships.

<h3 id="list-business-assets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|business_id|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the requesting business.|
|permissions|query|[[PermissionsWithOwner](#schemapermissionswithowner)]|false|A list of asset permissions used to filter the assets. Only assets where the requesting business has at least one of the specified permissions will be returned.|
|child_asset_id|query|string|false|A child asset unique identifier. Used to fetch asset groups that contain the asset id as a child.|
|asset_group_id|query|string|false|An asset group unique identifier. Used to fetch assets contained within the specified asset group.|
|asset_type|query|string|false|A resource type to filter the assets by. Only assets of the specified type will be returned.|
|start_index|query|integer|false|An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.|
|bookmark|query|string|false|Cursor used to fetch the next page of items|
|page_size|query|integer|false|Maximum number of items to include in a single page.<br>See documentation on [Pagination](/docs/reference/pagination/) for more information.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|permissions|ADMIN|
|permissions|ANALYST|
|permissions|FINANCE_MANAGER|
|permissions|FINANCE_EDIT|
|permissions|FINANCE_VIEW|
|permissions|AUDIENCE_MANAGER|
|permissions|CAMPAIGN_MANAGER|
|permissions|CATALOGS_MANAGER|
|permissions|CATALOGS_VIEWER|
|permissions|PROFILE_PUBLISHER|
|permissions|OWNER|
|asset_type|AD_ACCOUNT|

|asset_type|ASSET_GROUP|
|asset_type|CATALOG|

## Get assets assigned to a member

<a id="opIdbusiness_member_assets/get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.pinterest.com/v5/businesses/string/members/string/assets \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /businesses/{business_id}/members/{member_id}/assets`

Get assets on which you assigned asset permissions to the given member. Can be used to:
- get all assets, regardless of asset type or
- get assets of one asset type by using the asset_type query.
The return response will include the permissions the member has to that asset and the asset type.

## Get assets assigned to a partner or assets assigned by a partner

<a id="opIdbusiness_partner_asset_access/get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.pinterest.com/v5/businesses/string/partners/string/assets \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /businesses/{business_id}/partners/{partner_id}/assets`

Can be used to get the business assets your partner has granted you access to or the business assets you have
granted your partner access to. If you specify:
- partner_type=INTERNAL, you will retrieve your business assets that the partner has access to.
- partner_type=EXTERNAL, you will retrieve the partner's business assets that the partner has granted you access to.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|true|read-only|The ID of the advertiser that this ad belongs to.|
|ad_group_id|string|true|none|ID of the ad group that contains the ad.|
|android_deep_link|string \| null|false|none|Deep link URL for Android devices.|
|campaign_id|string|true|read-only|ID of the ad campaign that contains this ad.|
|carousel_android_deep_links|[string]|false|none|Comma-separated deep links for the carousel pin on Android.|
|carousel_destination_urls|[string]|false|none|Comma-separated destination URLs for the carousel pin to promote.|
|carousel_ios_deep_links|[string]|false|none|Comma-separated deep links for the carousel pin on iOS.|
|carting_platform_type|object|false|read-only|The vendor platform type of the carting/WTB ad.|
|carting_products|[[CartingProduct](#schemacartingproduct)]|false|read-only|Array of carting/WTB products for the ad.|
|click_tracking_url|string \| null|false|none|Tracking url for the ad clicks.|
|collection_items_destination_url_template|string \| null|false|none|Destination URL template for all items within a collections drawer.|
|collections_header_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|created_time|integer|false|read-only|Pin creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|creative_type|[CreativeType](#schemacreativetype)|true|none|Ad creative type enum.<br>**Note:** SHOP_THE_PIN has been deprecated. Please use COLLECTION instead.|
|customizable_cta_type|[CustomizableCTAType](#schemacustomizablectatype)|false|none|Select a call to action (CTA) to display below your ad. Available only for ads with direct links enabled. CTA options for consideration and conversion campaigns are LEARN_MORE, SHOP_NOW, BOOK_NOW, SIGN_UP, VISIT_SITE, BUY_NOW, GET_OFFER, ORDER_NOW, ADD_TO_CART (for conversion campaigns with add to cart conversion events only)|
|destination_url|string \| null|false|none|Destination URL.|
|disclosure_type|[DisclosureType](#schemadisclosuretype)|false|none|Type of information in the page referenced by `disclosure_url`, provided either by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or the manufacturer.|
|disclosure_url|string \| null|false|none|URL for a page that provides disclosures about a pharmaceutical product, such as potential side effects. Make sure the URL takes the user directly to the disclosure content and the referenced site is secure.|
|grid_click_type|[GridClickType](#schemagridclicktype)|false|none|Where a user is taken after clicking on an ad in grid.<br><br>**Note:**  This parameter is read-only and is set to `DIRECT_TO_DESTINATION` by default for direct links supported ads. `grid_click_type` values provided will be ignored.|
|id|string|true|none|The ID of this ad.|
|ios_deep_link|string \| null|false|none|Deep link URL for iOS devices.|
|is_carting|boolean|false|none|Is the ad a carting/WTB ad?|
|is_collage_accepted_terms|boolean|false|none|Whether the advertiser has accepted the terms and conditions for collage ad.|
|is_collage_single_destination|boolean|false|none|Whether the collage ad has a single destination url override.|
|is_pin_deleted|boolean|false|none|Is original pin deleted?|
|is_removable|boolean|false|none|Is pin repinnable?|
|lead_form_id|string \| null|false|none|Lead form ID for lead ad generation.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the ad - 255 chars max.|
|pin_id|string|true|none|Pin ID. This field may only be updated for draft ads.|
|quiz_pin_data|object \| null|false|none|Before creating a quiz ad, you must create an organic Pin using POST/Create Pin for each result in the quiz. Quiz ads cannot be saved by a Pinner. Quiz ad results can be saved.|
|rejected_reasons|[[AdDisapprovalReasons](#schemaaddisapprovalreasons)]|true|read-only|Enum reason why the pin was rejected. Returned if `review_status` is "REJECTED".|
|rejection_labels|[string]|true|read-only|Text reason why the pin was rejected. Returned if `review_status` is "REJECTED".|
|review_status|object|true|read-only|Ad review status|
|status|[EntityStatus](#schemaentitystatus)|false|none|Entity status|
|summary_status|object|true|read-only|Ad summary status|
|tracking_urls|[TrackingUrls](#schematrackingurls)|false|none|  Third-party tracking URLs. Up to three tracking URLs - with a max length of 2,000 - are supported for<br>  each event type. Tracking URLs set at the ad group or ad level can override<br>  those set at the campaign level. For more information, see [Third-party and dynamic tracking](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/third-party-and-dynamic-tracking).|
|type|string|true|read-only|Always "ad".|
|updated_time|integer|false|read-only|Last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|view_tracking_url|string \| null|false|none|Tracking URL for ad impressions.|

Retention applies to specific customers.)<br>ENGAGEMENT: {"engagement_domain": ["www.example.com"], "engager_type": 1}<br>Learn more about [engagement audiences](/docs/work-with-targets-and-audiences/create-audiences/#engagement-audience).|

JSON object defining targeted audience users. Example rule formats per audience type:
CUSTOMER_LIST: { "customer_list_id": "<customer list ID>"}
ACTALIKE: { "seed_id": ["<audience ID>"], "country": "US", "percentage": "10" }
(Valid countries include: "US", "CA", and "GB". Percentage should be 1-10.
The targeted audience should be this % size across Pinterest.)
VISITOR: { "visitor_source_id": ["<conversion tag ID>"], "retention_days": "180", "event_source": {"=": ["web", "mobile"]}, "ingestion_source": {"=": ["tag"]}}
(Retention days should be 1-540. Retention applies to specific customers.)
ENGAGEMENT: {"engagement_domain": ["www.example.com"], "engager_type": 1}
Learn more about [engagement audiences](/docs/work-with-targets-and-audiences/create-audiences/#engagement-audience).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|Ad account ID.|
|ad_id|[string]|false|none|Ad ID for engagement audience filter.|
|campaign_id|[string]|false|none|Campaign ID for engagement audience filter.|
|country|string|false|none|Valid countries include: "US", "CA", and "GB".|
|customer_list_id|string|false|none|Customer list ID. For CUSTOMER_LIST `audience_type`.|
|engagement_domain|[string]|false|none|The audience account's verified domain. **Required** for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`.|
|engagement_type|string|false|none|Engagement type enum. Optional for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`. Supported values are `click`, `save`, `closeup`, `comment` and `like`. All engagements are included if this field is not set.|
|engager_type|integer|false|none|Optional for ENGAGEMENT. Engager type value should be 1-2.|
|event|string|false|none|A Pinterest tag event. Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`. Possible values are `pagevisit`, `signup`, `checkout`, `viewcategory`, `search`, `addtocart`, `watchvideo`, `lead`, and `custom`. This field also accepts a partner-defined Pinterest tag event.|
|event_data|[EventData](#schemaeventdata)|false|none|    Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`.<br>    With the Pinterest tag, you can use event data to capture event details from your website.<br>    This object lists all the available predefined event data fields in the Pinterest tag.<br>    You can include these event data fields as part of a VISITOR audience’s `rule`; however, you **must** specify an `event` for the `event_data` fields to be evaluated.<br>    Besides what’s listed, you can also create your own set of `event_data` fields and define their usages or purposes according to your website needs.<br>    However, the benefit of using the predefined event data fields is that we can provide various metrics based on those fields' data.<br>    Examples per `event` type:<br>    `pagevisit`<br>    "event_data": { "page_name": "My online store 123 \| view items \| shoe" }<br>    `signup`<br>    "event_data": { "lead_type": "New release promotion" }<br>    `checkout`<br>    "event_data": { "value": 116, "order_quantity": 2, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Pillows (Set of 2)", "product_id": "11", "product_price": 48, "product_quantity": 1 }, { "product_name": "Pillows, Large (Set of 2)", "product_id": "15", "product_price": 68, "product_quantity": 1 } ] }<br>    `addtocart`<br>    "event_data": { "value": 499, "order_quantity": 1, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Red leather boots", "product_id": "3486", "product_category": "shoe", "product_variant_id": "JB11103000", "product_price": 499, "product_quantity": "1", "product_brand": "My brand" }]}<br>    `watchvideo`<br>    "event_data": { "video_title" : "My Product Video 01" }<br>    `lead`<br>    "event_data": { "lead_type": "Newsletter" }|
|event_source|object|false|none|Optional for VISITOR. You can use it as a {'=': [value]}. Supported values are: web, mobile, offline|
|ingestion_source|object|false|none|Optional for VISITOR. You can use it as a {'=': [value]}. Supported values are: tag, mmp, file_upload, conversions_api|
|objective_type|[[AudienceObjectiveType](#schemaaudienceobjectivetype)]|false|none|Objective for engagement audience filter.|
|percentage|string \| integer|false|none|Percentage should be 1-10. The targeted audience should be this % size across Pinterest.|
|pin_id|[string]|false|none|IDs of engaged organic pins. Optional for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`. For example, "pin_id:": ["34567"]|
|prefill|boolean|false|none|Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`. If `true`, the specified rule on existing engagement data is applied to pre-populate the audience. If `false`, the audience is empty at creation time. The default is `true`.|
|retention_days|integer|false|none|Number of days a Pinterest user remains in the audience. Optional for ENGAGEMENT and VISITOR `audience_type`. Accepted range is 1-540. Defaults to 180 if not specified.|
|seed_id|[integer] \| [string]|false|none|Audience ID(s). For ACTALIKE `audience_type`.|
|url|[string]|false|none|Optional for ENGAGEMENT or VISITOR `audience_type`.<br>For ENGAGEMENT, it is the engaged pin's URL.<br>For VISITOR, you can use it as a string or a {operator: value} object for filtering visitors based on conversion tag event URLs.<br>Supported operators are [ =, !=, contains, not_contains].<br>Example 1:  "url": "http://www.myonlinestore123.com/view_item/shoe"<br>Example 2: "url": {"contains": "/view_item/shoe"}|
|visitor_source_id|string \| [string]|false|none|The conversion tag ID, or the Pinterest tag ID, that you use on your website. For VISITOR `audience_type`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|objective_type|AWARENESS|
|objective_type|CONSIDERATION|
|objective_type|WEB_CONVERSION|
|objective_type|CATALOG_SALES|
|objective_type|VIDEO_COMPLETION|
|objective_type|SALES|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|read-only|Advertiser ID.|
|bid_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|Bid price in micro currency. This field is **REQUIRED** for the following campaign objective_type/billable_event combinations: AWARENESS/IMPRESSION, CONSIDERATION/CLICKTHROUGH, CATALOG_SALES/CLICKTHROUGH, VIDEO_VIEW/VIDEO_V_50_MRC.|
|bid_strategy_type|[BidStrategyType](#schemabidstrategytype)|false|none|Bid strategy type. For Campaigns with Video Completion objectives, the only supported bid strategy type is AUTOMATIC_BID, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ bidding".|
|billable_event|[ActionType](#schemaactiontype)|true|none|Ad group billable event type. For update, only draft ad groups may update billable event.|
|budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|Budget in micro currency. This field is **REQUIRED** for non-CBO (campaign budget optimization) campaigns.  A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. A CBO campaign is limited to 70 or less ad groups.|
|campaign_id|string|true|none|Campaign ID of the ad group.|
|conversion_learning_mode_type|object|true|read-only|oCPM learn mode|
|created_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|customer_segment_id|object|false|none|Customer segment ID applied to the ad group. We currently only support 1 customer segment per ad group. To use customer segments, do not set the `targeting_template_ids` field as well as the `AUDIENCE_INCLUDE` field of the `targeting_spec`. To clear the customer segment ID, set this field to '0'.|
|dca_assets|object|false|read-only|[DCA] The Dynamic creative assets to use for DCA. Dynamic Creative Assembly (DCA) accepts basic creative assets of an ad (image, video, title, call to action, logo etc). Then it automatically generates optimized ad combinations based on these assets.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the ad group stop appearing. If not specified, ads run indefinitely unless you update the ad group by changing their status to `paused`. Cannot occur after `end_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/ads-manager-schedule-ads). <br>For certain organizations ([Closed beta](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/beta-features)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). <br>For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|
|ext_features|[AdgroupTrackingFeatures](#schemaadgrouptrackingfeatures)|false|none|none|
|feed_profile_id|string|false|none|Feed Profile ID associated to the adgroup.|
|id|string|true|none|Ad group ID.|
|is_creative_optimization|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable creative optimization for the ad group, default value is FALSE. When enabled, you allow Pinterest to automatically turn your product Pins into ads in different formats (collections and shopping) and deliver those ads to users at scale.|
|is_local_inventory|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the ad group should use the local inventory.|
|lifetime_frequency_cap|integer|false|none|Set a limit to the number of times a promoted pin from this campaign can be impressed by a pinner within the past rolling 30 days. Only available for CPM (cost per mille (1000 impressions))  ad groups. A CPM ad group has an IMPRESSION [billable_event](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/billable-events) value. This field **REQUIRES** the `end_time` field.|
|local_inventory_radius_in_miles|number|false|none|The targeting radius of the local inventory ads in miles.|
|name|string|true|none|Ad group name.|
|optimization_goal_metadata|object \| null|false|none|Optimization goals for objective-based performance campaigns. **REQUIRED** when campaign's `objective_type` is set to `"WEB_CONVERSION"`.|
|performance_plus_campaign_settings|object \| null|false|none|Pinterest Performance+ campaign settings.|
|placement_group|object|false|none|[Placement group](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/placement-groups).|
|placement_traffic_type|object \| null|false|none|A targeting option that enables advertisers to choose whether to run ads in fullscreen feed, two column feed, or both|
|promotion_application_level|object \| null|false|none|Specify if the promotion is applied at ad group or item level|
|promotion_id|string \| null|false|none|Promotion ID. To clear this field, set to null.|
|promotion_ids|[string]|false|none|Promotion IDs list. To clear this field, set to an empty array [].|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the ad group start to appear. If not specified, ads appear during parent campaign's `start_time`. Cannot precede `start_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](/docs/api-features/managing-ads/#step-2-create-an-ad-group). For certain organizations ([Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|
|status|object|false|none|Ad group/entity status.|
|summary_status|object|true|read-only|none|
|targeting_spec|[TargetingSpecOptimal](#schematargetingspecoptimal)|false|none|none|
|targeting_template_ids|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|Targeting template IDs applied to the ad group. We currently only support 1 targeting template per ad group. To use targeting templates, do not set any other targeting fields: targeting_spec, tracking_urls, auto_targeting_enabled, placement_group. To clear all targeting template IDs, set this field to ['0'].|
|tracking_urls|[AdGroupTrackingURLs](#schemaadgrouptrackingurls)|false|none|  Third-party tracking URLs. Up to three tracking URLs - with a max length of 2,000 - are supported for<br>  each event type. Tracking URLs set at the ad group or ad level can override<br>  those set at the campaign level. For more information, see [Third-party and dynamic tracking](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/third-party-and-dynamic-tracking).|
|type|string|true|read-only|Always "adgroup".|
|updated_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|auto_targeting_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable auto-targeting for ad group. Default value is True. Also known as ["Performance+ targeting"](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/performance-plus-targeting).|
|bid_multiplier|number \| null|false|none|[Open beta](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/beta-features) Bid multiplier for ad group. This value is a double between 0.1 and 10.0. Enter 0 to remove the bid multiplier. - Not currently supported for [Performance+ campaigns](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/performance-plus-campaigns).|
|budget_type|[BudgetType](#schemabudgettype)|false|none|Budget type. If DAILY, an ad group's daily spend will not exceed the budget parameter value. If LIFETIME, the end_time parameter is **REQUIRED**, and the ad group spend is spread evenly between the ad group `start_time` and `end_time` range. A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. For CBO campaigns, only "CBO_ADGROUP" is allowed. For WEB_SESSIONS campaigns, only "LIFETIME" is allowed. For update, only draft ad groups may update budget type.|
|pacing_delivery_type|[PacingDeliveryType](#schemapacingdeliverytype)|false|none|Ad group pacing delivery type. With ACCELERATED, an ad group budget is spent as fast as possible. With STANDARD, an ad group budget is spent smoothly over a day. When using CBO, only the STANDARD pacing delivery type is allowed.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|read-only|Advertiser ID.|
|bid_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|Bid price in micro currency. This field is **REQUIRED** for the following campaign objective_type/billable_event combinations: AWARENESS/IMPRESSION, CONSIDERATION/CLICKTHROUGH, CATALOG_SALES/CLICKTHROUGH, VIDEO_VIEW/VIDEO_V_50_MRC.|
|bid_strategy_type|[BidStrategyType](#schemabidstrategytype)|false|none|Bid strategy type. For Campaigns with Video Completion objectives, the only supported bid strategy type is AUTOMATIC_BID, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ bidding".|
|billable_event|[ActionType](#schemaactiontype)|true|none|Ad group billable event type. For update, only draft ad groups may update billable event.|
|budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|Budget in micro currency. This field is **REQUIRED** for non-CBO (campaign budget optimization) campaigns.  A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. A CBO campaign is limited to 70 or less ad groups.|
|campaign_id|string|true|none|Campaign ID of the ad group.|
|conversion_learning_mode_type|object|true|read-only|oCPM learn mode|
|created_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|customer_segment_id|object|false|none|Customer segment ID applied to the ad group. We currently only support 1 customer segment per ad group. To use customer segments, do not set the `targeting_template_ids` field as well as the `AUDIENCE_INCLUDE` field of the `targeting_spec`. To clear the customer segment ID, set this field to '0'.|
|dca_assets|object|false|read-only|[DCA] The Dynamic creative assets to use for DCA. Dynamic Creative Assembly (DCA) accepts basic creative assets of an ad (image, video, title, call to action, logo etc). Then it automatically generates optimized ad combinations based on these assets.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the ad group stop appearing. If not specified, ads run indefinitely unless you update the ad group by changing their status to `paused`. Cannot occur after `end_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/ads-manager-schedule-ads). <br>For certain organizations ([Closed beta](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/beta-features)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). <br>For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|
|ext_features|[AdgroupTrackingFeatures](#schemaadgrouptrackingfeatures)|false|none|none|
|feed_profile_id|string|false|none|Feed Profile ID associated to the adgroup.|
|id|string|true|none|Ad group ID.|
|is_creative_optimization|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable creative optimization for the ad group, default value is FALSE. When enabled, you allow Pinterest to automatically turn your product Pins into ads in different formats (collections and shopping) and deliver those ads to users at scale.|
|is_local_inventory|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the ad group should use the local inventory.|
|lifetime_frequency_cap|integer|false|none|Set a limit to the number of times a promoted pin from this campaign can be impressed by a pinner within the past rolling 30 days. Only available for CPM (cost per mille (1000 impressions))  ad groups. A CPM ad group has an IMPRESSION [billable_event](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/billable-events) value. This field **REQUIRES** the `end_time` field.|
|local_inventory_radius_in_miles|number|false|none|The targeting radius of the local inventory ads in miles.|
|name|string|true|none|Ad group name.|
|optimization_goal_metadata|object \| null|false|none|Optimization goals for objective-based performance campaigns. **REQUIRED** when campaign's `objective_type` is set to `"WEB_CONVERSION"`.|
|performance_plus_campaign_settings|object \| null|false|none|Pinterest Performance+ campaign settings.|
|placement_group|object|false|none|[Placement group](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/placement-groups).|
|placement_traffic_type|object \| null|false|none|A targeting option that enables advertisers to choose whether to run ads in fullscreen feed, two column feed, or both|
|promotion_application_level|object \| null|false|none|Specify if the promotion is applied at ad group or item level|
|promotion_id|string \| null|false|none|Promotion ID. To clear this field, set to null.|
|promotion_ids|[string]|false|none|Promotion IDs list. To clear this field, set to an empty array [].|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the ad group start to appear. If not specified, ads appear during parent campaign's `start_time`. Cannot precede `start_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](/docs/api-features/managing-ads/#step-2-create-an-ad-group). For certain organizations ([Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|
|status|object|false|none|Ad group/entity status.|
|summary_status|object|true|read-only|none|
|targeting_spec|[TargetingSpecOptimal](#schematargetingspecoptimal)|false|none|none|
|targeting_template_ids|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|Targeting template IDs applied to the ad group. We currently only support 1 targeting template per ad group. To use targeting templates, do not set any other targeting fields: targeting_spec, tracking_urls, auto_targeting_enabled, placement_group. To clear all targeting template IDs, set this field to ['0'].|
|tracking_urls|[AdGroupTrackingURLs](#schemaadgrouptrackingurls)|false|none|  Third-party tracking URLs. Up to three tracking URLs - with a max length of 2,000 - are supported for<br>  each event type. Tracking URLs set at the ad group or ad level can override<br>  those set at the campaign level. For more information, see [Third-party and dynamic tracking](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/third-party-and-dynamic-tracking).|
|type|string|true|read-only|Always "adgroup".|
|updated_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|

|budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|Budget in micro currency. This field is **REQUIRED** for non-CBO (campaign budget optimization) campaigns.  A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. A CBO campaign is limited to 70 or less ad groups.|
|campaign_id|string|true|none|Campaign ID of the ad group.|
|conversion_learning_mode_type|object|true|read-only|oCPM learn mode|
|created_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|customer_segment_id|object|false|none|Customer segment ID applied to the ad group. We currently only support 1 customer segment per ad group. |dca_assets|object|false|read-only|[DCA] The Dynamic creative assets to use for DCA. Dynamic Creative Assembly (DCA) accepts basic creative assets of an ad (image, video, title, call to action, logo etc). Then it automatically generates optimized ad combinations based on these assets.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the ad group stop appearing. If not specified, ads run indefinitely unless you update the ad group by changing their status to `paused`. Cannot occur after `end_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/ads-manager-schedule-ads). <br>For certain organizations ([Closed beta](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/beta-features)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). <br>For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|
|ext_features|[AdgroupTrackingFeatures](#schemaadgrouptrackingfeatures)|false|none|none|
|feed_profile_id|string|false|none|Feed Profile ID associated to the adgroup.|
|id|string|true|none|Ad group ID.|

|is_local_inventory|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the ad group should use the local inventory.|

|local_inventory_radius_in_miles|number|false|none|The targeting radius of the local inventory ads in miles.|
|name|string|true|none|Ad group name.|

|performance_plus_campaign_settings|object \| null|false|none|Pinterest Performance+ campaign settings.|
|placement_group|object|false|none|[Placement group](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/placement-groups).|
|placement_traffic_type|object \| null|false|none|A targeting option that enables advertisers to choose whether to run ads in fullscreen feed, two column feed, or both|

Cannot precede `start_time` for parent campaign (if specified). Learn about [scheduling ads](/docs/api-features/managing-ads/#step-2-create-an-ad-group). For certain organizations ([Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)): Supported for campaigns with Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). For all organizations: Supported for campaigns without CBO.|

|targeting_spec|[TargetingSpecOptimal](#schematargetingspecoptimal)|false|none|none|

|type|string|true|read-only|Always "adgroup".|
|updated_time|integer|true|read-only|Ad group last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|auto_targeting_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable auto-targeting for ad group. Default value is True. Also known as ["Performance+ targeting"](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/performance-plus-targeting).|
|bid_multiplier|number|false|none|[Open beta](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/beta-features) Bid multiplier for ad group. This value is a double between 0.1 and 10.0. Enter 0 to remove the bid multiplier. - Not currently supported for [Performance+ campaigns](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/performance-plus-campaigns).|
|budget_type|[BudgetType](#schemabudgettype)|false|none|Budget type. If DAILY, an ad group's daily spend will not exceed the budget parameter value. If LIFETIME, the end_time parameter is **REQUIRED**, and the ad group spend is spread evenly between the ad group `start_time` and `end_time` range. A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. For CBO campaigns, only "CBO_ADGROUP" is allowed. <h2 id="tocS_AdvancedAuctionBidOptions">AdvancedAuctionBidOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadvancedauctionbidoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_AdvancedAuctionBidOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSadvancedauctionbidoptions"></a>
<a id="tocsadvancedauctionbidoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "app_type_multipliers": {
    "android_mobile": 1.1,
    "android_tablet": 1.1,
    "ipad": 1.2,
    "iphone": 1.2,
    "web": 0.9,
    "web_mobile": 0.8
  },
  "bid_in_micro_currency": 0,
  "placement_multipliers": {
    "browse": 0.9,
    "search": 1.2,
    "related_pins": 1.1
  }
}
```

Object describing a retail catalog item's bid options (bid price and bid multipliers).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|app_type_multipliers|[AppTypeMultipliers](#schemaapptypemultipliers)|false|none|This represents a mapping from app type targeting criteria to a bid price adjustment.<br><br>Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified app type in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All app type multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).|
|bid_in_micro_currency|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Bid price in micro currency. A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. A value of `null` will fallback to the ad group's `bid_in_micro_currency`.|
|placement_multipliers|[PlacementMultipliers](#schemaplacementmultipliers)|false|none|This represents a mapping from placement to a bid price adjustment.<br><br>Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified placement in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All placement multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).|

<h2 id="tocS_AgeBucketMultipliers">AgeBucketMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaagebucketmultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_AgeBucketMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocSagebucketmultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocsagebucketmultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "18-24": 0.9,
  "25-34": 1.1,
  "35-44": 1.2
}
```

This represents a mapping from age bucket to a bid price adjustment.

Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified age bucket in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All age bucket multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AGE_BUCKET|object|false|none|Age bucket identifier.|
|**additionalProperties**|[AgeBucketMultipliersAdditionalProperties](#schemaagebucketmultipliersadditionalproperties)|false|none|Bid multiplier value for age bucket targeting. Must be a float64.|


<h2 id="tocS_AppTypeMultipliers">AppTypeMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaapptypemultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_AppTypeMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocSapptypemultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocsapptypemultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "android_mobile": 1.1,
  "android_tablet": 1.1,
  "ipad": 1.2,
  "iphone": 1.2,
  "web": 0.9,
  "web_mobile": 0.8
}
```

This represents a mapping from app type targeting criteria to a bid price adjustment.

Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified app type in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All app type multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|APP_TYPE|object|false|none|App type identifier.|
|**additionalProperties**|number(double)|false|none|none|


JSON object defining targeted audience users. Example rule formats per audience type:

CUSTOMER_LIST: { "customer_list_id": "&lt;customer list ID&gt;"}

ACTALIKE: { "seed_id": ["&lt;audience ID&gt;"], "country": "US", "percentage": "10" }
(Valid countries include: "US", "CA", and "GB". Percentage should be 1-10.
The targeted audience should be this % size across Pinterest.)

VISITOR: { "visitor_source_id": ["&lt;conversion tag ID&gt;"], "retention_days": "180", "event_source": {"=": ["web", "mobile"]}, "ingestion_source": {"=": ["tag"]}}
(Retention days should be 1-540. Retention applies to specific customers.)

ENGAGEMENT: {"engagement_domain": ["www.example.com"], "engager_type": 1}
Learn more about [engagement audiences](/docs/work-with-targets-and-audiences/create-audiences/#engagement-audience).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|Ad account ID.|
|ad_id|[string]|false|none|Ad ID for engagement audience filter.|
|campaign_id|[string]|false|none|Campaign ID for engagement audience filter.|
|country|string|false|none|Valid countries include: "US", "CA", and "GB".|
|customer_list_id|string|false|none|Customer list ID. For CUSTOMER_LIST `audience_type`.|
|engagement_domain|[string]|false|none|The audience account's verified domain. **Required** for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`.|
|engagement_type|string|false|none|Engagement type enum. Optional for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`. Supported values are `click`, `save`, `closeup`, `comment` and `like`. All engagements are included if this field is not set.|
|engager_type|integer|false|none|Optional for ENGAGEMENT. Engager type value should be 1-2.|
|event|string|false|none|A Pinterest tag event. Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`. Possible values are `pagevisit`, `signup`, `checkout`, `viewcategory`, `search`, `addtocart`, `watchvideo`, `lead`, and `custom`. This field also accepts a partner-defined Pinterest tag event.|
|event_data|[EventData](#schemaeventdata)|false|none|    Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`.<br>    With the Pinterest tag, you can use event data to capture event details from your website.<br>    This object lists all the available predefined event data fields in the Pinterest tag.<br>    You can include these event data fields as part of a VISITOR audience’s `rule`; however, you **must** specify an `event` for the `event_data` fields to be evaluated.<br>    Besides what’s listed, you can also create your own set of `event_data` fields and define their usages or purposes according to your website needs.<br>    However, the benefit of using the predefined event data fields is that we can provide various metrics based on those fields' data.<br>    Examples per `event` type:<br>    `pagevisit`<br>    "event_data": { "page_name": "My online store 123 \| view items \| shoe" }<br>    `signup`<br>    "event_data": { "lead_type": "New release promotion" }<br>    `checkout`<br>    "event_data": { "value": 116, "order_quantity": 2, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Pillows (Set of 2)", "product_id": "11", "product_price": 48, "product_quantity": 1 }, { "product_name": "Pillows, Large (Set of 2)", "product_id": "15", "product_price": 68, "product_quantity": 1 } ] }<br>    `addtocart`<br>    "event_data": { "value": 499, "order_quantity": 1, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Red leather boots", "product_id": "3486", "product_category": "shoe", "product_variant_id": "JB11103000", "product_price": 499, "product_quantity": "1", "product_brand": "My brand" }]}<br>    `watchvideo`<br>    "event_data": { "video_title" : "My Product Video 01" }<br>    `lead`<br>    "event_data": { "lead_type": "Newsletter" }|
|event_source|object|false|none|Optional for VISITOR. You can use it as a {'=': [value]}. Supported values are: web, mobile, offline|
|ingestion_source|object|false|none|Optional for VISITOR. You can use it as a {'=': [value]}. Supported values are: tag, mmp, file_upload, conversions_api|
|objective_type|[[ObjectiveType](#schemaobjectivetype)]|false|none|Objective for engagement audience filter.|
|percentage|integer|false|none|Percentage should be 1-10. The targeted audience should be this % size across Pinterest.|
|pin_id|[string]|false|none|IDs of engaged organic pins. Optional for ENGAGEMENT `audience_type`. For example, "pin_id:": ["34567"]|
|prefill|boolean|false|none|Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`. If `true`, the specified rule on existing engagement data is applied to pre-populate the audience. If `false`, the audience is empty at creation time. The default is `true`.|
|retention_days|integer|false|none|Number of days a Pinterest user remains in the audience. Optional for ENGAGEMENT and VISITOR `audience_type`. Accepted range is 1-540. Defaults to 180 if not specified.|
|seed_id|[string]|false|none|Audience ID(s). For ACTALIKE `audience_type`.|
|url|[string]|false|none|Optional for ENGAGEMENT or VISITOR `audience_type`. For ENGAGEMENT, it is the engaged pin's URL. For VISITOR, you can use it as a string or a {operator: value} object for filtering visitors based on conversion tag event URLs. Supported operators are [ =, !=, contains, not_contains]. Example 1:  "url": "http://www.myonlinestore123.com/view_item/shoe" Example 2: "url": {"contains": "/view_item/shoe"}|
|visitor_source_id|string|false|none|The conversion tag ID, or the Pinterest tag ID, that you use on your website. For VISITOR `audience_type`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|objective_type|AWARENESS|
|objective_type|CONSIDERATION|
|objective_type|WEB_CONVERSION|
|objective_type|CATALOG_SALES|
|objective_type|VIDEO_COMPLETION|
|objective_type|SALES|
|objective_type|APP_INSTALL|
|objective_type|CTV_CONSIDERATION|

<h2 id="tocS_BidOptionsAgeBucketMultipliers">BidOptionsAgeBucketMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabidoptionsagebucketmultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_BidOptionsAgeBucketMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocSbidoptionsagebucketmultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocsbidoptionsagebucketmultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "18-24": 0,
  "25-34": 0,
  "35-44": 0,
  "45-49": 0,
  "50-54": 0,
  "55-64": 0,
  "65+": 0
}
```

This represents a mapping from age bucket to a bid price change value.

Values represent the change in bid price and can be positive or negative. For percentage changes, a value of 500.0 means a 5% change. For value changes, the amount represents the direct bid adjustment. All age bucket multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 0 (no bid adjustment). The change must still remain between the range of 0 and 10.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|18-24|number|false|none|none|
|25-34|number|false|none|none|
|35-44|number|false|none|none|
|45-49|number|false|none|none|
|50-54|number|false|none|none|
|55-64|number|false|none|none|
|65+|number|false|none|none|

```json
  "multiplier": 0
}
```

This represents a mapping from Audience ID to a bid price change value. This is paired with the bid_multipliers schedule type

Values represent the change in bid price and can be positive or negative. For percentage changes, a value of 500.0 means a 5% change. For value changes, the amount represents the direct bid adjustment. All audience multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 0 (no bid adjustment). The change must still remain between the range of 0 and 10.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audience_id|string|true|none|none|
|multiplier|number|true|none|none|

<a id="tocsbillinginvoice"></a>

```json
{
  "ad_account_id": "string",
  "ad_account_name": "string",
  "amount_billed_micro_currency": 0,
  "amount_discount_micro_currency": 0,
  "amount_net_micro_currency": 0,
  "amount_tax_micro_currency": 0,
  "bill_to_country": "string",
  "billing_period_end_date": "1970-01-01",
  "billing_period_start_date": "1970-01-01",
  "currency": "UNK",
  "document_type": {},
  "id": "string",
  "invoice_due_date": "1970-01-01",
  "payment_terms": "NET 30",
  "status": "OPEN"
}
```

A billing invoice in the advertiser account.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|The ID of the ad account this invoice belongs to|
|ad_account_name|string|false|none|The name of the ad account this invoice belongs to|
|amount_billed_micro_currency|integer|false|none|The amount billed in this invoice. Denoted in micro currency|
|amount_discount_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|The discount in this invoice. Denoted in micro currency|
|amount_net_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|The net amount in this invoice. Denoted in micro currency|
|amount_tax_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|The tax in this invoice. Denoted in micro currency|
|bill_to_country|string|false|none|The country of the bill to address|
|billing_period_end_date|string(date)|false|none|The end date of the billing period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD|
|billing_period_start_date|string(date)|false|none|The start date of the billing period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|false|none|Currency Codes from ISO 4217|
|document_type|object|false|none|The type of the document|
|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier for the billing invoice|
|invoice_due_date|string(date)|false|none|The date the invoice is due. Format: YYYY-MM-DD|
|payment_terms|string|false|none|The payment terms of the invoice|
|status|object|false|none|The status of the invoice|

Budget duration type for delivery estimates.

<h2 id="tocS_BudgetType">BudgetType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabudgettype"></a>
<a id="schema_BudgetType"></a>
<a id="tocSbudgettype"></a>
<a id="tocsbudgettype"></a>

```json
"DAILY"
```

Budget type. If DAILY, an ad group's daily spend will not exceed the budget parameter value. If LIFETIME, the end_time parameter is **REQUIRED**, and the ad group spend is spread evenly between the ad group `start_time` and `end_time` range. A CBO campaign automatically generates ad group budgets from its campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome. For CBO campaigns, only "CBO_ADGROUP" is allowed. For WEB_SESSIONS campaigns, only "LIFETIME" is allowed. For update, only draft ad groups may update budget type.

Two set of objects to be managed asyncronusly by bulk. One for creations, one for modifications.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|create|[BulkUpsertRequestCreate](#schemabulkupsertrequestcreate)|false|none|Request for creation of entities in bulk.|
|update|[BulkUpsertRequestUpdate](#schemabulkupsertrequestupdate)|false|none|Request for creation of entities in bulk.|

An object containing the permissions a business has on the asset.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|asset_group_info|object|false|none|An object containing all the information specific to the provided asset group. This field will be populated only if asset_type equals 'ASSET_GROUP'.|
|asset_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of a business asset.|
|asset_type|[AssetTypeResponse](#schemaassettyperesponse)|false|none|Type of asset. Currently we only support AD_ACCOUNT, PROFILE, ASSET_GROUP and CATALOG.|
|permissions|[string]|false|none|Permission levels the requesting business has on an asset.|
|catalog_info|object|false|none|An object containing all the information specific to the provided catalog. This field will be populated only if asset_type equals 'CATALOG'.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|asset_type|AD_ACCOUNT|
|asset_type|MERCHANT|
|asset_type|PROFILE|
|asset_type|ASSET_GROUP|
|asset_type|PINNER_LIST|
|asset_type|CONVERSION_TAG|
|asset_type|CATALOG|
|asset_type|CONVERSION_SEGMENT|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|Campaign's Advertiser ID.|
|bid_options|object|false|none|[Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Object describing the campaign level bid multipliers.|
|created_time|integer|false|read-only|Campaign creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|daily_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|When transitioning from campaign budget optimization to non-campaign budget optimization, the default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency will propagate to each child ad groups daily budget. Unit is micro currency of the associated advertiser account.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Note: To clear this field on update, set the end time to -1.<br>Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign stop appearing. Must occur after any end times for child ad groups. If `end_time` is not specified for the campaign, ads run indefinitely unless you update the campaign, changing their status to `paused`. Learn about [scheduling campaigns](/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling).<br>Different end times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur after an `end_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with an end time specified, and if you update that campaign with an `end_time` that is earlier than that of the ad group, the campaign `end_time` will supersede the ad group `end_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call [List campaigns](/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list) or [List ad groups](/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list), the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|id|string|true|none|Campaign ID, must be associated with the ad account ID provided in the path.|
|intended_promotion_type|[IntendedPromotionType](#schemaintendedpromotiontype)|false|none|Specifies the intended promotion type for the campaign.<br><br>Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br><br>**STANDARD_AD**<br>- For ads derived from Pins.<br>- Supported for all objective types except for current CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION, which are being deprecated.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**CATALOG**<br>- For creating product group promotions.<br>- Supported for CONSIDERATION and SALES objective types.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**LEGACY**<br>- Intended only for maintaining backward compatibility.<br>- Must be used for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION.<br>- Supported for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION objective types.<br><br>**If you do not provide this parameter, the default is:**<br>- LEGACY for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- STANDARD_AD for other objective types|
|is_automated_campaign|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.<br>When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.<br>The following objective types are supported:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES|
|is_campaign_budget_optimization|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.<br>When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.|
|is_carting|boolean|false|read-only|Whether the campaign contains a carting(where-to-buy link) ad.|
|is_flexible_daily_budgets|boolean \| null|false|none|Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".<br>Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.|
|is_ltv_optimized|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the campaign is optimized for Lifetime Value (LTV). Only available for eligible advertisers.|
|is_performance_plus|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES<br>- APP\_INSTALL<br>Enable Pinterest Performance+ for your campaign. To learn more, see [Pinterest Performance+ Setup](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api-features/pinterest-performance-plus-setup/)|
|is_top_of_search|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br> [Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br> Have your ads and content appear at the top of search result lists in Pinterest.<br> You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br> - CONSIDERATION<br> - WEB\_CONVERSION<br> - SALES<br> - LEADS<br> - CATALOG\_SALES<br> You cannot use this feature with Pinterest Performance+ or Premiere Spotlight enabled.|
|lifetime_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|name|string|false|none|Campaign name - 255 chars max.|
|objective_type|[CampaignObjectiveType](#schemacampaignobjectivetype)|true|none|Campaign objective type. If set as one of ["AWARENESS", "CONSIDERATION", "WEB_CONVERSION", "CATALOG_SALES", "VIDEO_COMPLETION", "CTV_CONSIDERATION"] the campaign is considered as a Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaign, meaning budget needs to be set at the campaign level rather than at the ad group level. ["WEB_SESSIONS"] is DEPRECATED. `VIDEO_VIEW` is deprecated; use `VIDEO_COMPLETION` instead. `CTV_CONSIDERATION` is in BETA. For update, only draft campaigns may update objective type.|
|order_line_id|string \| null|false|none|Note: To clear this field on update, set the order line ID to 0.<br>Order line ID that appears on the invoice. The order line must not be expired.|
|performance_plus_campaign_settings|object \| null|false|none|Pinterest Performance+ campaign settings.|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign start to appear. Must precede any start times set for child ad groups. Defaults to current time if no time is specified. Learn about [scheduling campaigns](/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling).<br>Different start times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur before a `start_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with a start time specified, and if you update that campaign with a `start_time` that is later than that of the ad group, the campaign `start_time` will supersede the ad group `start_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call [List campaigns](/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list) or [List ad groups](/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list), the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|status|[EntityStatus](#schemaentitystatus)|false|none|Entity status|
|summary_status|object|false|read-only|none|
|tracking_urls|object \| null|false|none|none|
|type|string|false|read-only|Always "campaign".|
|updated_time|integer|false|read-only|UTC timestamp. Last update time.|

<h2 id="tocS_CampaignAudienceMultipliers">CampaignAudienceMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacampaignaudiencemultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_CampaignAudienceMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocScampaignaudiencemultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocscampaignaudiencemultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "123": 1.1,
  "456": 1.2
}
```

This represents a mapping from Audience ID to a bid price adjustment.

Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified audience in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All audience multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AUDIENCE_ID|string|false|none|Audience ID for the multiplier.|

Campaign data in batch response, with all fields optional to support error cases where data may be empty.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|Campaign's Advertiser ID.|
|bid_options|object|false|none|[Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Object describing the campaign level bid multipliers.|
|created_time|integer|false|read-only|Campaign creation time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|daily_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|When transitioning from campaign budget optimization to non-campaign budget optimization, the default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency will propagate to each child ad groups daily budget. Unit is micro currency of the associated advertiser account.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Note: To clear this field on update, set the end time to -1.<br>Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign stop appearing. Must occur after any end times for child ad groups. If `end_time` is not specified for the campaign, ads run indefinitely unless you update the campaign, changing their status to `paused`. Learn about [scheduling campaigns](/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling).<br>Different end times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur after an `end_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with an end time specified, and if you update that campaign with an `end_time` that is earlier than that of the ad group, the campaign `end_time` will supersede the ad group `end_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call [List campaigns](/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list) or [List ad groups](/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list), the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|id|string|false|none|Campaign ID.|
|intended_promotion_type|[IntendedPromotionType](#schemaintendedpromotiontype)|false|none|Specifies the intended promotion type for the campaign.<br><br>Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br><br>**STANDARD_AD**<br>- For ads derived from Pins.<br>- Supported for all objective types except for current CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION, which are being deprecated.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**CATALOG**<br>- For creating product group promotions.<br>- Supported for CONSIDERATION and SALES objective types.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**LEGACY**<br>- Intended only for maintaining backward compatibility.<br>- Must be used for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION.<br>- Supported for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION objective types.<br><br>**If you do not provide this parameter, the default is:**<br>- LEGACY for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- STANDARD_AD for other objective types|
|is_automated_campaign|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.<br>When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.<br>The following objective types are supported:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES|
|is_campaign_budget_optimization|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.<br>When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.|
|is_carting|boolean|false|read-only|Whether the campaign contains a carting(where-to-buy link) ad.|
|is_flexible_daily_budgets|boolean \| null|false|none|Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".<br>Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.|
|is_ltv_optimized|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the campaign is optimized for Lifetime Value (LTV). Only available for eligible advertisers.|
|is_performance_plus|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES<br>- APP\_INSTALL<br>Enable Pinterest Performance+ for your campaign. To learn more, see [Pinterest Performance+ Setup](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api-features/pinterest-performance-plus-setup/)|
|is_top_of_search|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br> [Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br> Have your ads and content appear at the top of search result lists in Pinterest.<br> You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br> - CONSIDERATION<br> - WEB\_CONVERSION<br> - SALES<br> - LEADS<br> - CATALOG\_SALES<br> You cannot use this feature with Pinterest Performance+ or Premiere Spotlight enabled.|
|lifetime_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|name|string|false|none|Campaign name - 255 chars max.|
|objective_type|[CampaignObjectiveType](#schemacampaignobjectivetype)|false|none|Campaign objective type. If set as one of ["AWARENESS", "CONSIDERATION", "WEB_CONVERSION", "CATALOG_SALES", "VIDEO_COMPLETION", "CTV_CONSIDERATION"] the campaign is considered as a Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaign, meaning budget needs to be set at the campaign level rather than at the ad group level. ["WEB_SESSIONS"] is DEPRECATED. `VIDEO_VIEW` is deprecated; use `VIDEO_COMPLETION` instead. `CTV_CONSIDERATION` is in BETA. For update, only draft campaigns may update objective type.|
|order_line_id|string \| null|false|none|Note: To clear this field on update, set the order line ID to 0.<br>Order line ID that appears on the invoice. The order line must not be expired.|
|performance_plus_campaign_settings|object \| null|false|none|Pinterest Performance+ campaign settings.|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign start to appear. Must precede any start times set for child ad groups. Defaults to current time if no time is specified. Learn about [scheduling campaigns](/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling).<br>Different start times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur before a `start_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with a start time specified, and if you update that campaign with a `start_time` that is later than that of the ad group, the campaign `start_time` will supersede the ad group `start_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call [List campaigns](/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list) or [List ad groups](/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list), the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|status|object \| null|false|none|none|
|summary_status|object|false|read-only|none|
|tracking_urls|object \| null|false|none|none|
|type|string|false|read-only|Always "campaign".|
|updated_time|integer|false|read-only|UTC timestamp. Last update time.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** Setting this field does nothing. The ad account ID gets set from the path parameter.|
|app_id|string|false|none|[Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>The store ID of the mobile app for `APP_INSTALL` campaigns.|
|app_platform|object|false|none|[Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Platform of the mobile app for `APP_INSTALL` campaigns.|
|bid_options|object|false|none|[Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Object describing the campaign level bid multipliers.|
|daily_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Setting this field does nothing.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Note: To clear this field on update, set the end time to -1.<br>Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign stop appearing. Must occur after any end times for child ad groups. If `end_time` is not specified for the campaign, ads run indefinitely unless you update the campaign, changing their status to `paused`. Learn about [scheduling campaigns](/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling).<br>Different end times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur after an `end_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with an end time specified, and if you update that campaign with an `end_time` that is earlier than that of the ad group, the campaign `end_time` will supersede the ad group `end_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call [List campaigns](/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list) or [List ad groups](/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list), the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|intended_promotion_type|[IntendedPromotionType](#schemaintendedpromotiontype)|false|none|Specifies the intended promotion type for the campaign.<br><br>Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br><br>**STANDARD_AD**<br>- For ads derived from Pins.<br>- Supported for all objective types except for current CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION, which are being deprecated.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**CATALOG**<br>- For creating product group promotions.<br>- Supported for CONSIDERATION and SALES objective types.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**LEGACY**<br>- Intended only for maintaining backward compatibility.<br>- Must be used for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION.<br>- Supported for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION objective types.<br><br>**If you do not provide this parameter, the default is:**<br>- LEGACY for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- STANDARD_AD for other objective types|
|is_automated_campaign|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.<br>When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.<br>The following objective types are supported:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES|
|is_campaign_budget_optimization|boolean \| null|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.<br>When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.|
|is_flexible_daily_budgets|boolean \| null|false|none|Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".<br>Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.|
|is_ltv_optimized|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the campaign is optimized for Lifetime Value (LTV). Only available for eligible advertisers.|
|is_performance_plus|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- LEADS<br>- CATALOG\_SALES<br>- APP\_INSTALL<br>Enable Pinterest Performance+ for your campaign. To learn more, see [Pinterest Performance+ Setup](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api-features/pinterest-performance-plus-setup/)|
|is_top_of_search|boolean|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br> [Restricted](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br> Have your ads and content appear at the top of search result lists in Pinterest.<br> You can only use this feature with the following objectives:<br> - CONSIDERATION<br> - WEB\_CONVERSION<br> - SALES<br> - LEADS<br> - CATALOG\_SALES<br> You cannot use this feature with Pinterest Performance+ or Premiere Spotlight enabled.|
|lifetime_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Note: The default for this field is null, which is treated the same as 0.<br>For campaign budget optimization, a daily or lifetime spend cap must be set, but not both.<br>For ad group level budgets, this field must be 0 or unset.|
|name|string|true|none|Campaign name - 255 chars max.|

|objective_type|[ObjectiveType](#schemaobjectivetype)|true|none|Advertiser campaign objective type.<br>You can only update objectives for draft campaigns.<br>`CTV_CONSIDERATION` is in BETA.<br>`WEB_SESSIONS` and `VIDEO_VIEW` objectives are deprecated. |default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|When transitioning from campaign budget optimization to non-campaign budget optimization, the default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency will propagate to each child ad groups daily budget. Unit is micro currency of the associated advertiser account.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign stop appearing. Must occur after any end times for child ad groups. If `end_time` is not specified for the campaign, ads run indefinitely unless you update the campaign, changing their status to `paused`. Learn about <a href="/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling" target="blank">scheduling campaigns</a>.<br>Different end times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur after an `end_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with an end time specified, and if you update that campaign with an `end_time` that is earlier than that of the ad group, the campaign `end_time` will supersede the ad group `end_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call <a href="/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list" target="blank">List campaigns</a> or <a href="/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list" target="blank">List ad groups</a>, the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|is_automated_campaign|[CampaignIsAutomatedCampaign](#schemacampaignisautomatedcampaign)|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.<br>When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.<br>The following objective types are supported:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- CATALOG\_SALES|
|is_campaign_budget_optimization|[CampaignIsCampaignBudgetOptimization](#schemacampaigniscampaignbudgetoptimization)|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.<br>When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.|
|is_flexible_daily_budgets|[CampaignIsFlexibleDailyBudgets](#schemacampaignisflexibledailybudgets)|false|none|Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".<br>Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.|
|lifetime_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Campaign total spending cap. Required for Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaigns. This and "daily_spend_cap" cannot be set at the same time.|
|name|string|true|none|Campaign name.|
|order_line_id|string \| null|false|none|Order line ID that appears on the invoice.|
|start_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign start to appear. Must precede any start times set for child ad groups. Defaults to current time if no time is specified. Learn about <a href="/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling" target="blank">scheduling campaigns</a>.<br>Different start times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur before a `start_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with a start time specified, and if you update that campaign with a `start_time` that is later than that of the ad group, the campaign `start_time` will supersede the ad group `start_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call <a href="/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list" target="blank">List campaigns</a> or <a href="/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list" target="blank">List ad groups</a>, the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|

Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.
Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.
When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.
The following objective types are supported:
- CONSIDERATION
- WEB\_CONVERSION
- SALES
- CATALOG\_SALES

```json
true
```

Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.
Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.
When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.

Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".
Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.

Campaign objective type. If set as one of ["AWARENESS", "CONSIDERATION", "WEB_CONVERSION", "CATALOG_SALES", "VIDEO_COMPLETION", "CTV_CONSIDERATION"] the campaign is considered as a Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaign, meaning budget needs to be set at the campaign level rather than at the ad group level. ["WEB_SESSIONS"] is DEPRECATED. `VIDEO_VIEW` is deprecated; use `VIDEO_COMPLETION` instead. `CTV_CONSIDERATION` is in BETA. For update, only draft campaigns may update objective type.
