|intended_promotion_type|[IntendedPromotionType](#schemaintendedpromotiontype)|false|none|Specifies the intended promotion type for the campaign.<br><br>Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br><br>**STANDARD_AD**<br>- For ads derived from Pins.<br>- Supported for all objective types except for current CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION, which are being deprecated.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**CATALOG**<br>- For creating product group promotions.<br>- Supported for CONSIDERATION and SALES objective types.<br>- For simplified objective types.<br><br>**LEGACY**<br>- Intended only for maintaining backward compatibility.<br>- Must be used for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION.<br>- Supported for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION objective types.<br><br>**If you do not provide this parameter, the default is:**<br>- LEGACY for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- STANDARD_AD for other objective types|
|is_ltv_optimized|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the campaign is optimized for Lifetime Value (LTV). Only available for eligible advertisers.|
|is_performance_plus|boolean|false|none|Enable Pinterest Performance+ for your campaign. To learn more, see <a href="https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api-features/pinterest-performance-plus-setup/">Pinterest Performance+ Setup</a>. This field is immutable, except only for campaigns in draft status which may update this field.|
|is_top_of_search|boolean|false|none|Enable Top Of Search for your campaign. This field is immutable, except only for campaigns in draft status which may update this field.|
|objective_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|ad_account_id|string|true|none|Campaign's Advertiser ID. If you want to create a campaign in a Business Account shared account you need to specify the Business Access advertiser ID in both the query path param as well as the request body schema.|
|daily_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Campaign daily spending cap. Required for Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaigns. This and "lifetime_spend_cap" cannot be set at the same time.|
|default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency|integer \| null|false|none|When transitioning from campaign budget optimization to non-campaign budget optimization, the default_ad_group_budget_in_micro_currency will propagate to each child ad groups daily budget. Unit is micro currency of the associated advertiser account.|
|end_time|integer \| null|false|none|Timestamp in Unix format for scheduling when ads in the campaign stop appearing. Must occur after any end times for child ad groups. If `end_time` is not specified for the campaign, ads run indefinitely unless you update the campaign, changing their status to `paused`. Learn about <a href="/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling" target="blank">scheduling campaigns</a>.<br>Different end times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur after an `end_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with an end time specified, and if you update that campaign with an `end_time` that is earlier than that of the ad group, the campaign `end_time` will supersede the ad group `end_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call <a href="/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list" target="blank">List campaigns</a> or <a href="/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list" target="blank">List ad groups</a>, the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|
|id|string|true|none|Campaign ID.|
|is_automated_campaign|[CampaignIsAutomatedCampaign](#schemacampaignisautomatedcampaign)|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Specifies whether the campaign was created in the automated campaign flow.<br>When using Automated Campaigns, a daily spend cap must be set, and Pinterest Performance+ may not be used.<br>The following objective types are supported:<br>- CONSIDERATION<br>- WEB\_CONVERSION<br>- SALES<br>- CATALOG\_SALES|
|is_campaign_budget_optimization|[CampaignIsCampaignBudgetOptimization](#schemacampaigniscampaignbudgetoptimization)|false|none|Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.<br>Determines if a campaign automatically generates ad-group level budgets given a campaign budget to maximize campaign outcome.<br>When using campaign budgets with a lifetime spend cap, the end time must be provided.|
|is_flexible_daily_budgets|[CampaignIsFlexibleDailyBudgets](#schemacampaignisflexibledailybudgets)|false|none|Determine if a campaign has setup for flexible daily budgets, also known as "Pinterest Performance+ budgets".<br>Flexible daily budgets are only supported for campaign budget optimization with a daily spend cap, and not a lifetime spend cap.|
|lifetime_spend_cap|integer \| null|false|none|Campaign total spending cap. Required for Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) campaigns. This and "daily_spend_cap" cannot be set at the same time.|

Learn about <a href="/docs/api-features/managing-campaigns/#campaign-scheduling" target="blank">scheduling campaigns</a>.<br>Different start times can be set for the campaign's child ad groups, but they cannot occur before a `start_time` specified for the campaign.<br>- If your campaign has a child ad group with a start time specified, and if you update that campaign with a `start_time` that is later than that of the ad group, the campaign `start_time` will supersede the ad group `start_time`, and the request will not return an error.<br>- In this scenario, if you call <a href="/docs/api/v5/campaigns-list" target="blank">List campaigns</a> or <a href="/docs/api/v5/ad_groups-list" target="blank">List ad groups</a>, the returned campaigns or ad groups are listed with the start and end times that you assigned them, regardless of supersedence.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|catalog_id|string|true|none|Catalog id pertaining to the feed. If not provided, feed will use a default catalog based on type.|

<h2 id="tocS_CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule">CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule</h2>

<a id="tocscatalogsfeedprocessingschedule"></a>

```json
{
  "time": "string",
  "timezone": {}
}
```

Daily processing schedule. This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this to configure the preferred time for processing a feed (otherwise random).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|time|string|true|none|A time in format HH:MM with leading 0 (zero)|
|timezone|object|true|none|The timezone considered for the processing schedule time.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ADULT_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some items have invalid adult values.|
|ADWORDS_FORMAT_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some adwords links contain too many characters.|
|AVAILABILITY_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some items are missing an availability value in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|BLOCKLISTED_IMAGE_SIGNATURE|integer|false|none|Some items were not published because they don't meet Pinterest's Merchant Guidelines.|
|DELIMITER_ERROR|integer|false|none|Your feed includes data with formatting errors.|
|DESCRIPTION_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some items are missing a description in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|DUPLICATE_PRODUCTS|integer|false|none|Some products are duplicated.|
|ENCODING_ERROR|integer|false|none|Your feed includes data with an unsupported encoding format.|
|FEED_LENGTH_TOO_LONG|integer|false|none|Your feed contains too many items, some items will not be published.|
|FEED_TOO_SMALL|integer|false|none|Your feed couldn't be validated because the file doesn't contain the minimum number of lines required.|
|FETCH_ERROR|integer|false|none|Pinterest couldn't download your feed.|
|FETCH_INACTIVE_FEED_ERROR|integer|false|none|Your feed wasn't ingested because it hasn't changed in the previous 90 days.|
|IMAGE_LINK_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some image links are formatted incorrectly.|
|IMAGE_LINK_LENGTH_TOO_LONG|integer|false|none|Some items have image_link URLs that contain too many characters, so those items will not be published.|
|IMAGE_LINK_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some items are missing an image link URL in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|INTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR|integer|false|none|We experienced a technical difficulty and were unable to ingest your feed. The next ingestion will happen in 24 hours.|
|INVALID_DOMAIN|integer|false|none|Some of your product link values don't match the verified domain associated with this account.|
|ITEM_MAIN_IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_FAILURE|integer|false|none|Some items' main images can't be found.|
|ITEMID_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some items are missing an item id in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|LINK_FORMAT_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some link values are formatted incorrectly.|
|LINK_LENGTH_TOO_LONG|integer|false|none|Some product links contain too many characters, those items will not be published.|
|LIST_PRICE_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some items have list price formatting errors in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|MALFORMED_XML|integer|false|none|Your feed couldn't be validated because the xml file is formatted incorrectly.|
|MAX_ITEMS_PER_ITEM_GROUP_EXCEEDED|integer|false|none|Some items exceed the maximum number of items per item group, those items will not be published.|
|NO_VERIFIED_DOMAIN|integer|false|none|Your merchant domain needs to be claimed.|
|PARSE_LINE_ERROR|integer|false|none|Your feed contains formatting errors for some items.|
|PINJOIN_CONTENT_UNSAFE|integer|false|none|Some items were not published because they don't meet Pinterest's Merchant Guidelines.|
|PRICE_CANNOT_BE_DETERMINED|integer|false|none|Some items were not published because price cannot be determined. The price, list price, and sale price are all different, so those items will not be published.|
|PRICE_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some products are missing a price, those items will not be published.|
|PRODUCT_LINK_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some items are missing a link URL in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|PRODUCT_PRICE_INVALID|integer|false|none|Some items have price formatting errors in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|
|REQUIRED_COLUMNS_MISSING|integer|false|none|Your feed is missing some required column headers.|
|TITLE_MISSING|integer|false|none|Some items are missing a title in their product metadata, those items will not be published.|

<h2 id="tocS_CatalogsFeedVideoCounts">CatalogsFeedVideoCounts</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacatalogsfeedvideocounts"></a>
<a id="schema_CatalogsFeedVideoCounts"></a>
<a id="tocScatalogsfeedvideocounts"></a>
<a id="tocscatalogsfeedvideocounts"></a>

```json
{
  "ingested_videos": 0,
  "not_ingested_videos": 0,
  "total_videos": 0
}
```

Counts of total, ingested, and not ingested videos in the feed file. The counts may not appear early in the process.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ingested_videos|integer|false|none|The number of videos successfully ingested from the feed file.|
|not_ingested_videos|integer|false|none|The number of videos that were not ingested from the feed file.|
|total_videos|integer|false|none|The number of videos in the feed file.|

<h2 id="tocS_CatalogsFeedsCreateRequest">CatalogsFeedsCreateRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacatalogsfeedscreaterequest"></a>
<a id="schema_CatalogsFeedsCreateRequest"></a>
<a id="tocScatalogsfeedscreaterequest"></a>
<a id="tocscatalogsfeedscreaterequest"></a>

```json
{
  "credentials": {
    "password": "password",
    "username": "string"
  },
  "default_availability": "IN_STOCK",
  "default_country": "AD",
  "default_currency": "AED",
  "default_locale": "af-ZA",
  "format": "TSV",
  "location": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "preferred_processing_schedule": {
    "time": "string",
    "timezone": {}
  },
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}
```

Request object for creating a feed. Please, be aware that "default_country" and "default_locale" are not required in the spec for forward compatibility but for now the API will not accept requests without those fields.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credentials|[CatalogsFeedCredentials](#schemacatalogsfeedcredentials)|false|none|This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this if your feed file requires username and password.|
|default_availability|[ProductAvailabilityType](#schemaproductavailabilitytype)|false|none|Default availability for products in a feed.|
|default_country|[Country](#schemacountry)|false|none|Country ID from ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.|
|default_currency|[NullableCurrency](#schemanullablecurrency)|false|none|Currency Codes from ISO 4217.|
|default_locale|[CatalogsLocale](#schemacatalogslocale) \| [DeprecatedCatalogFeedsCreateRequestDefaultLocale](#schemadeprecatedcatalogfeedscreaterequestdefaultlocale)|false|none|The locale used within a feed for product descriptions.|
|format|[CatalogsFormat](#schemacatalogsformat)|true|none|The file format of a feed.|
|location|[FeedLocation](#schemafeedlocation)|true|none|The URL where a feed is available for download. This URL is what Pinterest will use to download a feed for processing.|
|name|[FeedDisplayName](#schemafeeddisplayname)|true|none|A human-friendly name associated to a given feed.|
|preferred_processing_schedule|[CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule](#schemacatalogsfeedprocessingschedule)|false|none|Daily processing schedule. This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this to configure the preferred time for processing a feed (otherwise random).|
|status|object|false|none|none|

|preferred_processing_schedule|[CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule](#schemacatalogsfeedprocessingschedule)|false|none|Daily processing schedule. This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this to configure the preferred time for processing a feed (otherwise random).|

|latitude|number|false|none|Latitude of the hotel.|
|link|string \| null|false|none|Link to the product page|
|longitude|number \| null|false|none|Longitude of the hotel.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|The hotel's name.|
|neighborhood|[string]|false|none|A list of neighborhoods where the hotel is located|

|TOO_MANY_ADDITIONAL_IMAGE_LINKS|object|false|none|Item has a additional_image_link value that exceed the limit for additional images, this item will be published without some of your images.|
|UTM_SOURCE_AUTO_CORRECTED|object|false|none|Item includes an utm_source value that is formatted incorrectly and has been automatically corrected.|
|VIDEO_REQUIRED_WHEN_AD_VIDEO_PROVIDED|object|false|none|A video is required in the item when ad_video fields are provided.|
|WEIGHT_UNIT_INVALID|object|false|none|Item has a weight_unit value that is formatted incorrectly, this item will be published without a weight unit.|

Catalog product group type

- **MERCHANT_CREATED**: Product groups created by merchants.
- **ALL_PRODUCTS**: Consists of every product in your latest successful feed upload.
- **BEST_DEALS**: Consists of products with the deepest drop in price.
- **PINNER_FAVORITES**: Consists of products that are resonating most with people on Pinterest, based on engagement.
- **TOP_SELLERS**: Consists of products with the highest conversion rate, if you have the conversion tag installed.
- **BACK_IN_STOCK**: Consists of products that were previously out of stock and are now in stock.
- **NEW_ARRIVALS**: Consists of products that are new to your Catalog.
- **SHOPIFY_COLLECTIONS**: Product groups created based on Shopify Product Collections.
- **I2PC**: Product groups created based on predicted product category.
- **CATALOG_EXPANSION**: Consists of high-potential, recommended products from your catalog.

|items|[[CatalogsRetailBatchRequestItemsItems](#schemacatalogsretailbatchrequestitemsitems)]|true|none|Array with catalogs item operations|
|language|[CatalogsLocale](#schemacatalogslocale) \| [Language](#schemalanguage)|true|none|We recommend using the CatalogsLocale values.|

Catalogs Retail Feed object

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|catalog_type|string|true|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|read-only|none|
|credentials|[CatalogsFeedCredentials](#schemacatalogsfeedcredentials)|false|none|This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this if your feed file requires username and password.|
|default_availability|[ProductAvailabilityType](#schemaproductavailabilitytype)|false|none|Default availability for products in a feed.|
|default_country|[Country](#schemacountry)|true|none|Country ID from ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.|
|default_currency|[NullableCurrency](#schemanullablecurrency)|false|none|Currency Codes from ISO 4217.|
|default_locale|string|true|none|The locale used within a feed for product descriptions.|
|format|[CatalogsFormat](#schemacatalogsformat)|true|none|The file format of a feed.|
|id|string|true|read-only|ID of the feed entity.|
|location|string|true|none|The URL where a feed is available for download. This URL is what Pinterest will use to download a feed for processing.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|A human-friendly name associated to a given feed. This value is currently nullable due to historical reasons. It is expected to become non-nullable in the future.|
|preferred_processing_schedule|[CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule](#schemacatalogsfeedprocessingschedule)|false|none|Daily processing schedule. This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this to configure the preferred time for processing a feed (otherwise random).|
|status|[CatalogsStatus](#schemacatalogsstatus)|true|none|Status for catalogs entities. Present in catalogs_feed values. When a feed is deleted, the response will inform DELETED as status.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|read-only|none|

Request object for creating a retail feed.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|catalog_id|string|false|none|Catalog id pertaining to the feed. If not provided, feed will use a default catalog based on type.|
|catalog_type|string|true|none|none|
|credentials|[CatalogsFeedCredentials](#schemacatalogsfeedcredentials)|false|none|This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this if your feed file requires username and password.|
|default_availability|[ProductAvailabilityType](#schemaproductavailabilitytype)|false|none|Default availability for products in a feed.|
|default_country|[Country](#schemacountry)|true|none|Country ID from ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.|
|default_currency|[NullableCurrency](#schemanullablecurrency)|false|none|Currency Codes from ISO 4217.|
|default_locale|[CatalogsLocale](#schemacatalogslocale) \| [DeprecatedCatalogFeedsCreateRequestDefaultLocale](#schemadeprecatedcatalogfeedscreaterequestdefaultlocale)|true|none|The locale used within a feed for product descriptions.|
|format|[CatalogsFormat](#schemacatalogsformat)|true|none|The file format of a feed.|
|location|[FeedLocation](#schemafeedlocation)|true|none|The URL where a feed is available for download. This URL is what Pinterest will use to download a feed for processing.|
|name|[FeedDisplayName](#schemafeeddisplayname)|true|none|A human-friendly name associated to a given feed.|
|preferred_processing_schedule|[CatalogsFeedProcessingSchedule](#schemacatalogsfeedprocessingschedule)|false|none|Daily processing schedule. This field is **OPTIONAL**. Use this to configure the preferred time for processing a feed (otherwise random).|

|created_at|integer|false|none|Unix timestamp in seconds of when catalog product group was created.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|none|

|status|[CatalogsProductGroupStatus](#schemacatalogsproductgroupstatus)|false|none|none|
|type|[CatalogsProductGroupType](#schemacatalogsproductgrouptype)|true|none|Catalog product group type<br><br>- **MERCHANT_CREATED**: Product groups created by merchants.<br>- **ALL_PRODUCTS**: Consists of every product in your latest successful feed upload.<br>- **BEST_DEALS**: Consists of products with the deepest drop in price.<br>- **PINNER_FAVORITES**: Consists of products that are resonating most with people on Pinterest, based on engagement.<br>- **TOP_SELLERS**: Consists of products with the highest conversion rate, if you have the conversion tag installed.<br>- **BACK_IN_STOCK**: Consists of products that were previously out of stock and are now in stock.<br>- **NEW_ARRIVALS**: Consists of products that are new to your Catalog.<br>- **SHOPIFY_COLLECTIONS**: Product groups created based on Shopify Product Collections.<br>- **I2PC**: Product groups created based on predicted product category.<br>- **CATALOG_EXPANSION**: Consists of high-potential, recommended products from your catalog.|
|updated_at|integer|false|none|Unix timestamp in seconds of last time catalog product group was updated.|

|report_type|string|true|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|report_type|ALL_ITEMS|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action_source|string|true|none|The source indicating where the conversion event occurred.<br>- `app_android`<br>- `app_ios`<br>- `web`<br>- `offline`|
|app_id|string \| null|false|none|The app store app ID.|
|app_info|[ConversionEventAppInfo](#schemaconversioneventappinfo)|false|none|Object containing information about the application where event occurred.|
|app_name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the app.|
|app_version|string \| null|false|none|Version of the app.|
|custom_data|[ConversionEventsDataItemsCustomData](#schemaconversioneventsdataitemscustomdata)|false|none|Object containing other custom data.|
|device_brand|string \| null|false|none|Brand of the user device.|
|device_carrier|string \| null|false|none|User device's mobile carrier.|
|device_info|[ConversionEventDeviceInfo](#schemaconversioneventdeviceinfo)|false|none|Object containing information about the device where event occurred.|
|device_model|string \| null|false|none|Model of the user device.|
|device_type|string \| null|false|none|Type of the user device.|
|event_id|string|true|none|A unique id string that identifies this event and can be used for deduping between events ingested via both the conversion API and Pinterest tracking. Without this, event's data is likely to be double counted and will cause report metric inflation. Third-party vendors make sure this field is updated on both Pinterest tag and Conversions API side before rolling out template for Conversions API.|
|event_name|string|true|none|The type of the user event. Please use the right event_name; otherwise the event will not be accepted and show up correctly in reports.<br><br>- `add_payment_info`<br>- `add_to_cart`<br>- `add_to_wishlist`<br>- `app_install`<br>- `app_open`<br>- `checkout`<br>- `contact`<br>- `custom`<br>- `customize_product`<br>- `find_location`<br>- `initiate_checkout`<br>- `lead`<br>- `page_visit`<br>- `schedule`<br>- `search`<br>- `signup`<br>- `start_trial`<br>- `submit_application`<br>- `subscribe`<br>- `view_category`<br>- `view_content`<br>- `watch_video`|
|event_source_url|string \| null|false|none|URL of the web conversion event.|
|event_time|integer(int64)|true|none|The time when the event happened. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|language|string \| null|false|none|Two-character ISO-639-1 language code indicating the user's language.|
|opt_out|boolean|false|none|When action_source is web or offline, it defines whether the user has opted out of tracking for web conversion events. While when action_source is app_android or app_ios, it defines whether the user has enabled Limit Ad Tracking on their iOS device, or opted out of Ads Personalization on their Android device.|
|os_version|string \| null|false|none|Version of the device operating system.|
|partner_name|string \| null|false|none|The third party partner name responsible to send the event to Conversions API on behalf of the advertiser. The naming convention is "ss-partnername" lowercase. E.g 'ss-shopify'|
|user_data|object|true|none|Object containing customer information data. Note, It is required at least one of 1) em, 2) hashed_maids or 3) pair client_ip_address + client_user_agent.|
|wifi|boolean|false|none|Whether the event occurred when the user device was connected to wifi.|

Object containing other custom data.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|content_brand|string \| null|false|none|The brand of the content associated with the event.|
|content_category|string \| null|false|none|The category of the content associated with the event.|
|content_ids|[string]|false|none|List of products IDs. We recommend using this if you are a merchant for PageVisit, AddToCart and Checkouts. For detail, please check [here](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/before-you-get-started-with-catalogs) (Install the Pinterest tag section).|
|content_name|string \| null|false|none|The name of the page or product associated with the event.|
|contents|[[ConversionEventsDataItemsCustomDataContentsItems](#schemaconversioneventsdataitemscustomdatacontentsitems)]|false|none|A list of objects containing information about products, such as price and quantity. We recommend using this if you are a merchant for PageVisit, AddToCart and Checkouts. For detail, please check [here](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/before-you-get-started-with-catalogs) (Install the Pinterest tag section).|
|currency|string \| null|false|none|The ISO-4217 currency code. If not provided, we will default to the advertiser's currency set during account creation. Your campaign performance needs this field to report right ROAS/CPA.|
|external_measurement_id|string \| null|false|none|Only use when instructed.|
|external_measurement_vendor_id|integer \| null|false|none|Only use when instructed.|
|np|string \| null|false|none|Named partner. Not required, this is for Pinterest internal use only. Please do not use this unless specifically guided.|
|num_items|integer(int64)|false|none|Total number of products of the event. For example, the total number of items purchased in a checkout event. We recommend using this if you are a merchant for AddToCart and Checkouts. For detail, please check [here](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/before-you-get-started-with-catalogs) (Install the Pinterest tag section).|
|opt_out_type|string \| null|false|none|Flags for different privacy rights laws to opt out users of sharing personal information. Separate values with commas. See the Help Center article about [limited data processing](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/limited-data-processing) and the developer's guide for [tracking conversion events](/docs/track-conversions/track-conversions-in-the-api/#whether-the-user-has-opted-out-of-web-or-offline-conversion-events) for help with using this parameter.|
|order_id|string \| null|false|none|The order ID. We recommend sending order_id to help us deduplicate events when necessary. This also helps to run other measurement products at Pinterest.|
|predicted_ltv|string \| null|false|none|Predicted lifetime value of user associated with the event. Accepted as a string in the request; it will be parsed into a double.|
|search_string|string \| null|false|none|The search string related to the user conversion event.|
|value|string \| null|false|none|Total value of the event. Accepted as a string in the request; it will be parsed into a double. For example, if there are two items in a checkout event, the value should be the total price. We recommend to use pre-tax, pre-shipping final value.|

|item_brand_id|string|false|none|The brand ID of a product.|
|item_category|string|false|none|The category of a product.|
|item_name|string|false|none|The name of a product.|
|item_price|string|false|none|The price of a product. Accepted as a string in the request; it will be parsed into a double. This is the original item value before any discount. We recommend using this if you are a merchant for PageVisit, AddToCart and Checkouts. For detail, please check [here](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/before-you-get-started-with-catalogs) (Install the Pinterest tag section).|
|quantity|integer(int64)|false|none|The amount of a product. We recommend using this if you are a merchant for AddToCart and Checkouts. For detail, please check [here](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/before-you-get-started-with-catalogs) (Install the Pinterest tag section).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|click_id|string \| null|false|none|The unique identifier stored in _epik cookie on your domain or &epik= query parameter in the URL. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA.|
|client_ip_address|string|false|none|The user's IP address, which can be either in IPv4 or IPv6 format. Used for matching. We highly recommend this for all events. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA.|
|client_user_agent|string|false|none|The user agent string of the user's web browser. We highly recommend this for all events. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA.|
|country|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of two-character ISO-3166 country code indicating the user's country, in lowercase. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|ct|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's city, in lowercase, and without spaces or punctuation. User residency city (mostly billing). The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|db|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's date of birthday, given as year, month, and day. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|em|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of lowercase version of user's email addresses. Used for matching. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|external_id|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of the unique id from the advertiser that identifies a user in their space, e.g. user id, loyalty id, etc. We highly recommend this on all events. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|fn|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's first name, in lowercase. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|ge|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's gender, in lowercase. Either "f" or "m" or "n" for non-binary gender. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|hashed_maids|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's "Google Advertising IDs" (GAIDs) or "Apple's Identifier for Advertisers" (IDFAs). Used for matching. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|ln|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's last name, in lowercase. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|partner_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier of visitors' information defined by third party partners. e.g RampID|
|ph|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's phone numbers, only digits with country code, area code, and number. Remove any symbols, letters, spaces and leading zeros. We highly recommend this on checkout events at least. It may improve reporting performance such as ROAS/CPA. The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|st|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's state, given as a two-letter code in lowercase. User residency state (mostly billing). The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|
|zp|[string]|false|none|Sha256 hashes of user's zipcode, only digits. User residency zipcode (mostly billing). The string should be in the UTF-8 format.|

<a id="tocsconversionmsoteventscreate"></a>

```json
{
  "action_timestamps": [
    1451410040
  ],
  "ad_group_id": "2680060704746",
  "attribution_model": "multi_touch",
  "attribution_scope": "click",
  "attribution_score": 0.5,
  "campaign_id": "626736533506",
  "click_window": "string",
  "currency": {},
  "event_id": "eventId0001",
  "event_name": "add_to_cart",
  "event_timestamp": 1451431341,
  "total_event_touchpoints": 2,
  "total_events": 2,
  "total_events_fractional": 0.1,
  "value": 123.45,
  "view_window": "string"
}
```

Resource create operation model.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action_timestamps|[integer(int64)]|false|none|Timestamp(s) when the ad action(s) happened. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|ad_group_id|object|true|none|The ID of the ad group that was attributed to the conversion event.|
|attribution_model|object|false|none|The attribution model used to attribute the conversion event.|
|attribution_scope|object|false|none|Ad event type.|
|attribution_score|number(double)|false|none|Credit given to the attributed ad actions. Allowed values are > 0 and <= 1.|
|campaign_id|object|false|none|The ID of the campaign that was attributed to the conversion event.|
|click_window|string|false|none|Click window used for attribution (for example, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`).|
|currency|object|false|none|Currency code for the `value` field, required if `value` is present. Currency Codes should be in ISO 4217 standard.|
|event_id|string|true|none|A unique id string that identifies this event. If you are already sending us events through Conversions API,<br>then this id should match the event_id sent through Conversions API.|
|event_name|object|true|none|Type of user event.|
|event_timestamp|integer(int64)|true|none|The time when the event occurred. Unix timestamp in seconds.|
|total_event_touchpoints|integer|false|none|Total number of ad events including other non-Pinterest ad platforms.|
|total_events|integer|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated: use `total_events_fractional` instead to avoid rounding errors.<br>Total number of conversion events that are reported in one API call.<br><br>If you are sending one API request for one attributed conversion event then this value should be 1.<br>If you are sending multiple attributed conversion events in one API request then this value should be<br>the total number of attributed conversion events in the request.|
|total_events_fractional|number(double)|false|none|Total number of conversion events that are reported in one API call. Use this field instead of<br>`total_events` to send precise fractional values.<br><br>If you are sending one API request for one attributed conversion event with full credit, this value should be 1.0.<br>For partial attribution, send the exact fractional value (e.g., 0.5 for half credit).|
|value|number(double)|false|none|Order value of the conversion event. Required if `event_name` is `add_to_cart` or `checkout`.|
|view_window|string|false|none|View window used for attribution (for example, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`).|

```json
  "columns": [
    "AD_GROUP_ID"
  ],
  "conversion_product_attribution_type": "DEFAULT",
  "conversion_product_breakdown": "PRODUCT_BRAND",
  "conversion_report_time": "TIME_OF_AD_ACTION",
  "end_date": "2024-04-23",
  "granularity": {},
  "level": {},
  "product_sku_ids": [

    "WBC45679"
  ],
  "report_name": "string",
  "start_date": "2024-04-17",
  "view_window_days": 30
}
```

Resource create operation model.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_group_ids|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|  List of ad group ids.<br>  Only support ad_group_ids field when level of the report is AD_GROUP.|
|campaign_ids|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|  List of campaign ids.<br>  Only support campaign_ids field when level of the report is CAMPAIGN.|
|campaign_objective_types|[[ConversionObjectiveType](#schemaconversionobjectivetype)]|false|none|List of values for filtering. Default is ['CONSIDERATION','AWARENESS','WEB_CONVERSION','VIDEO_COMPLETION'].|
|click_window_days|object|false|none|Number of days to use as the conversion attribution window for a pin click action. Applies to Pinterest Tag conversion metrics. Prior conversion tags use their defined attribution windows. If not specified, defaults to `30` days.|
|columns|[[ConversionProductReportingColumn](#schemaconversionproductreportingcolumn)]|true|none|Metric and entity columns|
|conversion_product_attribution_type|object|false|none|  Required attribution type of the B/C/S report.<br>  When the attribution type is BRAND_ATTRIBUTION, start_date for the report must be after 2025-04-01.|
|conversion_product_breakdown|object|false|none|Report breakdown type. This is used to specify the breakdown of the report by brand, category, or SKU.|
|conversion_report_time|object|false|none|The date by which the conversion metrics returned from this endpoint will be reported. There are two dates associated with a conversion event: the date that the user interacted with the ad, and the date that the user completed a conversion event.|
|end_date|string|true|none|  Metric report end date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.<br>  A max of 1 year is allowed between the start and end date for reports.|
|granularity|object|true|none|Report granularity for time-based metric aggregation|
|level|object|true|none|Level of the report|
|product_sku_ids|[[Pinterest.Lib.AlphaNumericFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.alphanumericformattype)]|false|none|  List of SKU ids.<br>  Only support product_sku_ids field when report breakdown type is PRODUCT_SKU_GROUP.|
|report_name|string|true|none|Name of the conversion product report|
|start_date|string|true|none|  Metric report start date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.<br>  Start date must be after 2024-03-16. 7 day minimum time window for report is required.|
|view_window_days|object|false|none|Number of days to use as the conversion attribution window for a view action. Applies to Pinterest Tag conversion metrics. Prior conversion tags use their defined attribution windows. If not specified, defaults to `1` day.|

```json
{
  "ad_account_id": "549756359984",
  "created_time": 1452208622,
  "exceptions": {},

  "is_nca": true,
  "name": "The Glengarry Glen Ross leads",
  "num_batches": 2,
  "num_removed_user_records": 0,

  "type": "customerlist",
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|ad_account_id|string|false|read-only|Associated ad account ID.|

|exceptions|object|false|read-only|Customer list errors.|
|id|string|true|read-only|Customer list ID.|

|name|string|true|none|Customer list name.|
|num_batches|number|false|read-only|Total number of list updates. List creation counts as one batch. Each [Append](/docs/redoc/#operation/ads_v3_customer_list_add_handler_PUT) or [Remove API](/docs/redoc/#operation/ads_v3_customer_list_remove_handler_PUT) call counts as another. List creation via the **Ads Manager** UI could result in more than one batch since the UI breaks up large lists.|
|num_removed_user_records|number|false|read-only|Number of removed user records. In a [Remove API](/docs/redoc/#operation/ads_v3_customer_list_remove_handler_PUT) call, this counter increases even if the user is not found in the list.|
|num_uploaded_user_records|number|false|read-only|Number of uploaded user records. In an [Append API](/docs/redoc/#operation/ads_v3_customer_list_add_handler_PUT) call, this counter increases even if the uploaded user is already in the list.|
|status|object|false|read-only|Customer list status. `TOO_SMALL` means the list has fewer than 100 Pinterest users.|
|type|string|false|read-only|Always `customerlist`.|
|updated_time|number|false|read-only|Last update time. Unix timestamp in seconds.|

<h2 id="tocS_EventData">EventData</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaeventdata"></a>
<a id="schema_EventData"></a>
<a id="tocSeventdata"></a>
<a id="tocseventdata"></a>

```json
{
  "currency": {},
  "lead_type": "Newsletter",
  "line_items": {
    "product_brand": "Parker",
    "product_category": "Shoes",
    "product_id": 1414,
    "product_name": "Parker Boots",
    "product_price": "99.99",
    "product_quantity": 2,
    "product_variant": "Red",
    "product_variant_id": "1414-34832"
  },
  "order_id": "X-151481",
  "order_quantity": 1,
  "page_name": "Our Favorite Pins on Pinterest",
  "promo_code": "WINTER10",
  "property": "Athleta",
  "search_query": "boots",
  "value": "199.98",
  "video_title": "How to style your Parker Boots"
}
```

    Optional for VISITOR `audience_type`.
    With the Pinterest tag, you can use event data to capture event details from your website.
    This object lists all the available predefined event data fields in the Pinterest tag.
    You can include these event data fields as part of a VISITOR audience’s `rule`; however, you **must** specify an `event` for the `event_data` fields to be evaluated.
    Besides what’s listed, you can also create your own set of `event_data` fields and define their usages or purposes according to your website needs.
    However, the benefit of using the predefined event data fields is that we can provide various metrics based on those fields' data.
    Examples per `event` type:
    `pagevisit`
    "event_data": { "page_name": "My online store 123 | view items | shoe" }
    `signup`
    "event_data": { "lead_type": "New release promotion" }
    `checkout`
    "event_data": { "value": 116, "order_quantity": 2, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Pillows (Set of 2)", "product_id": "11", "product_price": 48, "product_quantity": 1 }, { "product_name": "Pillows, Large (Set of 2)", "product_id": "15", "product_price": 68, "product_quantity": 1 } ] }
    `addtocart`
    "event_data": { "value": 499, "order_quantity": 1, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [ { "product_name": "Red leather boots", "product_id": "3486", "product_category": "shoe", "product_variant_id": "JB11103000", "product_price": 499, "product_quantity": "1", "product_brand": "My brand" }]}
    `watchvideo`
    "event_data": { "video_title" : "My Product Video 01" }
    `lead`
    "event_data": { "lead_type": "Newsletter" }

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|object|false|none|Currency. For example, 'USD'.|
|lead_type|string|false|none|Promotion code. For example, 'Newsletter'.|
|line_items|object|false|none|none|
|order_id|string|false|none|Order ID. For example, 'X-151481'.|
|order_quantity|integer|false|none|Order quantity. For example, 1.|
|page_name|string|false|none|Page name. For example, 'Our Favorite Pins on Pinterest'.|
|promo_code|string|false|none|Promotion code. For example, 'WINTER10'.|
|property|string|false|none|Property. For example, 'Athleta'.|
|search_query|string|false|none|Search query string. For example, 'boots'.|
|value|string|false|none|Product value. For example, '199.98'.|
|video_title|string|false|none|Video title. For example, 'How to style your Parker Boots'.|

<h2 id="tocS_FrequencyMultipliers">FrequencyMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafrequencymultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_FrequencyMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocSfrequencymultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocsfrequencymultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "0": 1.5,
  "1": 1.3,
  "2": 0.8
}
```

This represents a mapping from impression count to a bid price adjustment for frequency-based bidding.

Keys are impression counts (0-10) representing how many times a user has seen the ad.
Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price.
A value of 0 will stop distribution for this impression count.
If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|IMPRESSION_COUNT|string|false|none|Impression count identifier.|
|**additionalProperties**|number(double)|false|none|none|

```json
  "male": 0.8
}
```

This represents a mapping from gender targeting criteria to a bid price adjustment.

Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified gender in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All gender multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|GENDER|object|false|none|Gender identifier.|
|**additionalProperties**|[GenderMultipliersAdditionalProperties](#schemagendermultipliersadditionalproperties)|false|none|Bid multiplier value for gender targeting. Must be a float64.|

<h2 id="tocS_IntendedPromotionType">IntendedPromotionType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaintendedpromotiontype"></a>
<a id="schema_IntendedPromotionType"></a>
<a id="tocSintendedpromotiontype"></a>
<a id="tocsintendedpromotiontype"></a>

```json
"LEGACY"
```

Specifies the intended promotion type for the campaign.

Note: This field is immutable unless the campaign is in draft status.

**STANDARD_AD**
- For ads derived from Pins.
- Supported for all objective types except for current CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION, which are being deprecated.
- For simplified objective types.

**CATALOG**
- For creating product group promotions.
- Supported for CONSIDERATION and SALES objective types.
- For simplified objective types.

**LEGACY**
- Intended only for maintaining backward compatibility.
- Must be used for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION.
- Supported for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION objective types.

**If you do not provide this parameter, the default is:**
- LEGACY for CATALOG\_SALES and WEB\_CONVERSION
- STANDARD_AD for other objective types

Object describing an item processing record

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|errors|[[ItemValidationEvent](#schemaitemvalidationevent)]|false|none|Array with the validation errors for the item processing record. A non empty errors list causes the item processing to fail.|
|item_id|string|false|none|The catalog item id in the merchant namespace|
|status|[ItemProcessingStatus](#schemaitemprocessingstatus)|false|none|The status of the item processing record|
|warnings|[[ItemValidationEvent](#schemaitemvalidationevent)]|false|none|Array with the validation warnings for the item processing record|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|SUCCESS|
|status|FAILURE|
|status|PROCESSING|

The access level a member/partner has to the business. Values are case-sensitive.
- EMPLOYEE: Can only view and access ad accounts you assign to them. They cannot see details about other employees, external partners or other ad accounts.
- BIZ_ADMIN: Have full control of roles and can add employees, external partners as well as grant ad account access.

<a id="schemametricsresponsedataitems"></a>
<a id="schema_MetricsResponseDataItems"></a>
<a id="tocSmetricsresponsedataitems"></a>
<a id="tocsmetricsresponsedataitems"></a>

```json
{
  "metrics": {},
  "targeting_type": "string",
  "targeting_value": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|metrics|object|true|none|Metrics object containing the requested metric columns and their values. The keys are metric names (e.g., AD_GROUP_ID, DATE, SPEND_IN_DOLLAR) and values are the metric values (strings or numbers).|
|targeting_type|string|true|none|The targeting type for this data item (e.g., KEYWORD, APPTYPE, GENDER)|
|targeting_value|string|true|none|The targeting value for this data item (e.g., 'christmas decor ideas', 'iphone', 'female')|

|refresh_token_expires_at|integer|false|read-only|none|
|refresh_token_expires_in|integer|false|read-only|none|

|scope|string|false|none|none|
|token_type|string|true|read-only|none|

<h2 id="tocS_OauthAccessTokenCreate">OauthAccessTokenCreate</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaoauthaccesstokencreate"></a>
<a id="schema_OauthAccessTokenCreate"></a>
<a id="tocSoauthaccesstokencreate"></a>
<a id="tocsoauthaccesstokencreate"></a>

```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "continuous_refresh": "string",
  "grant_type": "authorization_code",
  "redirect_uri": "string",
  "refresh_token": "string",
  "scope": "string"
}
```

Resource create operation model.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|string|false|none|none|
|continuous_refresh|string|false|none|  If your app was created before **September 25, 2025**, set to `true` to generate a [continuous refresh token](/docs/getting-started/set-up-authentication-and-authorization/#exchange-the-default-refresh-token-for-a-continuous-refresh-token), which has a 60-day expiration window. We no longer support the legacy refresh token, which has a 365-day expiration window.<br><br>  If your app was created on or after **September 25, 2025**, ignore this parameter. You automatically receive a continuous refresh token when you request an access token.|
|grant_type|[TokenGrantType](#schematokengranttype)|true|none|The type of OAuth grant being requested.|
|redirect_uri|string|false|none|none|
|refresh_token|string|false|none|none|
|scope|string|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|grant_type|authorization_code|
|grant_type|refresh_token|
|grant_type|client_credentials|

Advertiser campaign objective type.
You can only update objectives for draft campaigns.
`CTV_CONSIDERATION` is in BETA.
`WEB_SESSIONS` and `VIDEO_VIEW` objectives are deprecated. We recommend using `VIDEO_COMPLETION` as an alternative for the latter.

<h2 id="tocS_PlacementMultipliers">PlacementMultipliers</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaplacementmultipliers"></a>
<a id="schema_PlacementMultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocSplacementmultipliers"></a>
<a id="tocsplacementmultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "browse": 0.9,
  "search": 1.2,
  "related_pins": 1.1
}
```

This represents a mapping from placement to a bid price adjustment.

Multiplier values must be between 0 and 10. A value of 10 represents a 900% increase in bid price (from $1 to $10 for example). A value of 0 will stop distribution for this item on the specified placement in `MAX_BID` ad groups in `CATALOG_SALES` campaigns. All placement multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 1 (no bid adjustment).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|PLACEMENT|object|false|none|Placement type identifier.|
|**additionalProperties**|number(double)|false|none|none|


Select whether to promote the image or video pin by default for items in the promoted product group. If selecting IMAGE, image will be promoted for all ads in the product group, and when selecting VIDEO, video will be promoted when present, otherwise fall back to image. This is applicable for standard shopping ads only.

Product category details

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|demographics|[ProductCategoriesDemographic](#schemaproductcategoriesdemographic)|false|none|Age and gender distribution who engaged with this product category in the past 3 months|
|has_prediction|boolean|true|none|    Indicates whether the keyword has a prediction available for the next 90 days.<br>    This field is only applicable when include_prediction query parameter is set to true.<br>    By default, the value is false and no prediction data is included in the response.|
|metrics_highlights|[ProductCategoriesMetricsHighlights](#schemaproductcategoriesmetricshighlights)|false|none|Key performance metrics highlights for this product category|
|predicted_time_series|object|false|none|    A sequence of weekly observations of the predicted relative search volume for this keyword over the next 3 months.<br>    These values are normalized to a [0-100] range, and can be used to visualize the forecasted user interest in this keyword.<br>    Similar to the historical time_series, normalization is applied independently to the predicted time series of each keyword, but the normalize_against_group query parameter can be used in cases where you wish to compare relative predicted volume between keywords.<br>    **Note**: The cut-off date between historical and predicted time series depends on Pinterest data availability. Usually the data needs a few days to be calculated, so the predicted time series may contain some past dates compared to today.<br>    **Note**: The date of each observation is in ISO-8601 format and represents the end of the week. For example, a value of 2024-01-07 would include predicted searches for the week ending on 2024-01-07.|
|product_category|[ProductCategoryEnum](#schemaproductcategoryenum)|true|none|List of product category details|
|related_searches|[string]|false|none|Related search terms for this product category|
|time_series|object|false|none|Time series data showing trend values over time, indexed between 0 and 100|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_group_id|string|false|none|ID of the ad group the product group belongs to.|
|bid_in_micro_currency|integer|false|none|The bid in micro currency.|
|catalog_product_group_id|string|false|none|ID of the catalogs product group that this product group promotion references (required for create operations)|
|catalog_product_group_name|string|false|none|Catalogs product group name|
|collections_header_type|[CollectionsHeaderType](#schemacollectionsheadertype)|false|none|Collections ad header type|
|collections_hero_destination_url|string \| null|false|none|Collections Hero Destination Url|
|collections_hero_pin_id|string \| null|false|none|Hero Pin ID if this PG is promoted as a Collection|
|creative_type|[CreativeType](#schemacreativetype)|false|none|Ad creative type enum.<br>**Note:** SHOP_THE_PIN has been deprecated. Please use COLLECTION instead.|
|customizable_cta_type|[ProductGroupPromotionCustomizableCTAType](#schemaproductgrouppromotioncustomizablectatype)|false|none|Select a call to action (CTA) to display below your ad. CTA options for catalog sales campaigns are SHOP_NOW, BOOK_NOW, ON_SALE, GET_DEAL, BUY_ONLINE_PICKUP_IN_STORE|
|definition|string|false|none|The full product group definition path|
|grid_click_type|[GridClickType](#schemagridclicktype)|false|none|Where a user is taken after clicking on an ad in grid.<br><br>**Note:**  This parameter is read-only and is set to `DIRECT_TO_DESTINATION` by default for direct links supported ads. `grid_click_type` values provided will be ignored.|
|id|string|false|none|ID of the product group promotion (required for update operations).|
|included|boolean|false|none|True if the group is BIDDABLE, false if it should be EXCLUDED from serving ads.|
|is_generate_background|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable generate backgrounds for the product group, default value is FALSE. When enabled, Pinterest will use generative AI to apply backgrounds for your product images that help drive user inspiration and engagement.|
|is_image_auto_resizing|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to `TRUE` to automatically resize your product images with generative AI. This ensures that images have optimal appearance for better performance.|
|is_mdl|boolean|false|none|If set to true products promoted in this product group will use the Mobile Deep Link specified in your catalog|
|parent_id|string|false|none|The parent Product Group ID of this Product Group|
|preferred_media_type|[PreferredMediaType](#schemapreferredmediatype)|false|none|Select whether to promote the image or video pin by default for items in the promoted product group. If selecting IMAGE, image will be promoted for all ads in the product group, and when selecting VIDEO, video will be promoted when present, otherwise fall back to image. This is applicable for standard shopping ads only.|
|relative_definition|string|false|none|The definition of the product group, relative to its parent - an attribute name/value pair|
|selected_image_tag|string \| null|false|none|The ad image tag selected for the product group promotion.|
|selected_video_tag|string \| null|false|none|The ad video tag selected for the product group promotion.|
|slideshow_collections_description|string \| null|false|none|Slideshow Collections Description|
|slideshow_collections_title|string \| null|false|none|Slideshow Collections Title|
|status|[EntityStatus](#schemaentitystatus)|false|none|Entity status|
|tracking_url|string|false|none|Tracking template for proudct group promotions. 4000 limit|

```json
{
```

```json
  "end_time": 0,

  "id": "string",
  "platform_type": "string",
  "promotion_code": "string",
  "promotion_custom_id": "string",
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ad_account_id|string|true|read-only|The Ad Account ID that this promotion belongs to.|
|discount_status|[DiscountStatus](#schemadiscountstatus)|false|none|Discount status based on the current time and start and end time of discount|
|end_time|integer|false|none|Promotion end time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Independent of campaign end time.|
|external_id|string|false|none|Platform-specific ID for this promotion. Will be null for promotions first created within Pinterest.|
|id|string|true|none|Promotion ID|
|platform_type|string|false|none|The source integration platform used when creating the promotion. Currently supported values are 'DEFAULT' and 'SHOPIFY'.|
|promotion_code|string|false|none|Code that can be used to redeem a promotion.|
|promotion_custom_id|string|false|none|An optional field for user defined promotion ID for this promotion. Will copy from Pinterest system generated ID if user did not provide one.|
|promotion_title|string|true|none|Internal name for the promotion.|
|promotion_type|[PromotionType](#schemapromotiontype)|true|none|Determines the displayed promotion text along with what parameters (if any) are needed to complete the template.|
|start_time|integer|false|none|Promotion start time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Independent of campaign start time.|
|status|object|false|read-only|none|
|template_values|[[PromotionTemplateValue](#schemapromotiontemplatevalue)]|false|none|List of values to be inserted in the promotion type-specific template.|

|promotion_type|FIXED|
|promotion_type|PERCENT_OFF_CLEARANCE|
|promotion_type|X_OFF_Y|
|promotion_type|GIFT_WITH_FIRST_PURCHASE|

|promotion_type|CASH_BACK|

<h2 id="tocS_ScheduleAgeBucketMultipliers">ScheduleAgeBucketMultipliers</h2>

<a id="schemascheduleagebucketmultipliers"></a>

<a id="tocsscheduleagebucketmultipliers"></a>

```json
{
  "AGE_BUCKET": "18-24",
  "property1": 0,
  "property2": 0
}
```

This represents a mapping from age bucket to a bid price change value.
Values represent the change in bid price and can be positive or negative. For percentage changes, a value of 500.0 means a 5% change. For value changes, the amount represents the direct bid adjustment. All age bucket multipliers must be set at the same time. If a multiplier is not provided it is assumed to be 0 (no bid adjustment). The change must still remain between the range of 0 and 10.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AGE_BUCKET|string|false|none|none|
|**additionalProperties**|number(double)|false|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|AGE_BUCKET|35-44|
|AGE_BUCKET|45-49|
|AGE_BUCKET|50-54|
|AGE_BUCKET|55-64|
|AGE_BUCKET|65+|

<h2 id="tocS_TargetingSpec">TargetingSpec</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematargetingspec"></a>
<a id="schema_TargetingSpec"></a>
<a id="tocStargetingspec"></a>
<a id="tocstargetingspec"></a>

```json
{
  "AGE_BUCKET": [
    "35-44",
    "50-54"
  ],
  "APPTYPE": [
    "ipad",
    "iphone"
  ],
  "AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "AUDIENCE_INCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "GENDER": [
    "unknown"
  ],
  "GEO": [
    "string"
  ],
  "GEO_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "INTEREST": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCALE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCATION": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCATION_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "MAXIMUM_AGE": "65+",
  "MINIMUM_AGE": "18",
  "SHOPPING_RETARGETING": [
    {
      "lookback_window": 30,
      "exclusion_window": 14,
      "tag_types": [
        0,
        6
      ]
    }
  ],
  "TARGETING_STRATEGY": [
    "CHOOSE_YOUR_OWN"
  ]
}
```

Ad group targeting specification defining the ad group target audience. For example, `{"APPTYPE":["iphone"], "GENDER":["male"], "LOCALE":["en-US"], "LOCATION":["501"], "MINIMUM_AGE":"18", "MAXIMUM_AGE":"65+"}`

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AGE_BUCKET|[[TargetingSpecAgeBucket](#schematargetingspecagebucket)]|false|none|**Legacy field.** Predefined age ranges. We recommend using MINIMUM_AGE and MAXIMUM_AGE instead for more flexible targeting. Cannot be combined with MINIMUM_AGE/MAXIMUM_AGE. If neither AGE_BUCKET nor MINIMUM_AGE/MAXIMUM_AGE are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|APPTYPE|[[TargetingSpecAppType](#schematargetingspecapptype)]|false|none|Allowed devices. If the APPTYPE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All devices/apptypes** will be targeted.|
|AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE|[string]|false|none|Excluded customer list IDs. Used to drive new customer acquisition goals. For example: ["2542620905475"]. Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them. If the AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **No users will be excluded**.|
|AUDIENCE_INCLUDE|[string]|false|none|Targeted customer list IDs. For example: ["2542620905473"]. Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them. If the AUDIENCE_INCLUDE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All users will be included**.|
|GENDER|[[TargetingSpecGender](#schematargetingspecgender)]|false|none|Targeted genders. Values: ["unknown","male","female"]. If the GENDER field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All genders will be targeted**.|
|GEO|[string]|false|none|Region codes or postal codes to include for targeting.<br /><br /> Region codes represent broader geographical areas. Example: <code>US-CA</code> is the region code for California in the United States.<br /><br /> Postal codes represent more granular, specific areas. Example: <code>94103</code> is a postal code for a specifc area in San Francisco, California, U.S.A.<br /><br /> For each ad group, use only one of these methods, depending on which fits your targeting needs. Do not use both. For example, either specify a broader region code like <code>US-CA</code> or a more granular postal code within that regon, such as <code>94103</code>.<br /><br /> You can specify multiple region codes or postal codes in an array, depending on which method you choose.<br /><br /> Precede a region code array with the <code>region_codes</code> key and a postal code value with the <code>postal_codes</code> key. Examples:<br /><br /><br><code>"geo": {</code><br /> <code>"region_codes": ["US-CA"]</code><br /> <code>}</code><br /><br /><br><code>"geo": {</code><br /> <code>"postal_codes": ["94103"]</code><br /> <code>}</code><br /><br /><br>For each ad group, specify at least one <code>GEO</code> or <code>LOCATION</code>. <br /><br /> If you do not specifiy a <code>GEO</code> code, only <code>LOCATION</code> values will be targeted (See <code>LOCATION</code> parameter in this targeting spec.).<br /><br /> Learn how to <a href="/docs/analytics-and-reports/ads-reporting/#get-all-available-codes-and-zones" target="_blank">get a current, complete list of codes</a>.|
|GEO_EXCLUDE|[string]|false|none|Region codes or postal codes to exclude from the targeting inclusion area.<br /><br /> See <code>GEO</code> parameter in this targeting spec for rules, syntax, and other information.<br />|
|INTEREST|[string]|false|none|Array of interest object IDs. If the INTEREST field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All interests will be targeted**.|
|LOCALE|[string]|false|none|24 ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes. If the LOCALE field is not included in the request, all languages are targeted.|
|LOCATION|[string]|false|none|Metropolitan codes and/or ISO-Alpha-2, two-letter country codes to include for targeting.<br /><br /> Precede country code values with the <code>country_codes</code> key and metro code values with <code>metro_codes</code> key. Example:<br /><br /> <code>"location": {</code><br /> <code>"country_codes": ["US", "CA"],</code><br /> <code>"metro_codes": ["501", "602"]</code><br /> <code>}</code><br /><br /> For each ad group, specify at least one <code>GEO</code> or <code>LOCATION</code> code. <br /><br /> If you do not specify a <code>LOCATION</code> code, only <code>GEO</code> values will be targeted (See <code>GEO</code> parameter in this targeting spec.).<br /><br /> Learn how to <a href="/docs/analytics-and-reports/ads-reporting/#get-all-available-codes-and-zones" target="_blank">get a current, complete list of codes</a>.|
|LOCATION_EXCLUDE|[string]|false|none|Metropolitan codes and/or ISO-Alpha-2, two-letter country codes to exclude from targeting.<br /><br /> See <code>LOCATION</code> parameter in this targeting spec for rules, syntax, and other information.|
|MAXIMUM_AGE|string|false|none|Maximum age to target (inclusive). Values: "18", "19", ..., "65", "65+". Must be used together with `MINIMUM_AGE`. Cannot be combined with `AGE_BUCKET`. If neither `MINIMUM_AGE`/`MAXIMUM_AGE` nor `AGE_BUCKET` are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|MINIMUM_AGE|string|false|none|Minimum age to target (inclusive). Values: "18", "19", ..., "65". Note: 65+ is not allowed for minimum age. Must be used together with `MAXIMUM_AGE`. Cannot be combined with `AGE_BUCKET`. If neither `MINIMUM_AGE`/`MAXIMUM_AGE` nor `AGE_BUCKET` are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|SHOPPING_RETARGETING|[[TargetingSpecShoppingRetargeting](#schematargetingspecshoppingretargeting)]|false|none|Array of object: lookback_window	[Integer]: Number of days ago to start lookback timeframe for dynamic retargeting tag_types [Array of integer]: Event types to target for dynamic retargeting exclusion_window [Integer]: Number of days ago to stop lookback timeframe for dynamic retargeting|
|TARGETING_STRATEGY|[string]|false|none|none|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematargetingspecoptimal"></a>
<a id="schema_TargetingSpecOptimal"></a>
<a id="tocStargetingspecoptimal"></a>
<a id="tocstargetingspecoptimal"></a>

```json
{
  "AGE_BUCKET": [
    "18-24"
  ],
  "APPTYPE": [
    "android_mobile"
  ],
  "AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "AUDIENCE_INCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "GENDER": [
    "unknown"
  ],
  "GEO": [
    "string"
  ],
  "GEO_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "INTEREST": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCALE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCATION": [
    "string"
  ],
  "LOCATION_EXCLUDE": [
    "string"
  ],
  "MAXIMUM_AGE": "string",
  "MINIMUM_AGE": "string",
  "SHOPPING_RETARGETING": [
    {
      "lookback_window": 30,
      "exclusion_window": 14,
      "tag_types": [
        0,
        6
      ]
    }
  ],
  "TARGETING_STRATEGY": [
    "CHOOSE_YOUR_OWN"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AGE_BUCKET|[[TargetingSpecAgeBucket](#schematargetingspecagebucket)]|false|none|**Legacy field.** Predefined age ranges. We recommend using MINIMUM_AGE and MAXIMUM_AGE instead for more flexible targeting. Cannot be combined with MINIMUM_AGE/MAXIMUM_AGE. If neither AGE_BUCKET nor MINIMUM_AGE/MAXIMUM_AGE are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|APPTYPE|[[TargetingSpecAppType](#schematargetingspecapptype)]|false|none|Allowed devices. If the APPTYPE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All devices/apptypes** will be targeted.|
|AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|Excluded customer list IDs. Used to drive new customer acquisition goals. For example: ["2542620905475"]. Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them. If the AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **No users will be excluded**.|
|AUDIENCE_INCLUDE|[[Pinterest.Lib.IntegerFormatType](#schemapinterest.lib.integerformattype)]|false|none|Targeted customer list IDs. For example: ["2542620905473"]. Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them Audience lists need to have at least 100 people with Pinterest accounts in them. If the AUDIENCE_INCLUDE field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All users will be included**.|
|GENDER|[[TargetingSpecGender](#schematargetingspecgender)]|false|none|Targeted genders. Values: ["unknown","male","female"]. If the GENDER field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All genders will be targeted**.|
|GEO|[string]|false|none|Region codes or postal codes to include for targeting.<br><br>Region codes represent broader geographical areas. Example: `US-CA` is the region code for California in the United States.<br><br>Postal codes represent more granular, specific areas. Example: `94103` is a postal code for a specifc area in San Francisco, California, U.S.A.<br><br>For each ad group, use only one of these methods, depending on which fits your targeting needs. Do not use both. For example, either specify a broader region code like `US-CA` or a more granular postal code within that regon, such as `94103`.<br><br>You can specify multiple region codes or postal codes in an array, depending on which method you choose.<br><br>Precede a region code array with the `region_codes` key and a postal code value with the `postal_codes` key. Examples:<br><br>```<br>"geo": {<br>  "region_codes": ["US-CA"]<br>}<br>```<br><br>```<br>"geo": {<br>  "postal_codes": ["94103"]<br>}<br>```<br><br>For each ad group, specify at least one `GEO` or `LOCATION`.<br><br>If you do not specifiy a `GEO` code, only `LOCATION` values will be targeted (See `LOCATION` parameter in this targeting spec.).<br><br>Learn how to [get a current, complete list of codes](/docs/analytics-and-reports/ads-reporting/#get-all-available-codes-and-zones).|
|GEO_EXCLUDE|[string]|false|none|[Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Region codes or postal codes to exclude from the targeting inclusion area.<br><br>See `GEO` parameter in this targeting spec for rules, syntax, and other information.|
|INTEREST|[string]|false|none|Array of interest object IDs. If the INTEREST field is missing, the default behavior in terms of ad delivery is that **All interests will be targeted**.|
|LOCALE|[string]|false|none|24 ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes. If the LOCALE field is not included in the request, all languages are targeted.|
|LOCATION|[string]|false|none|Metropolitan codes and/or ISO-Alpha-2, two-letter country codes to include for targeting.<br><br>Precede country code values with the `country_codes` key and metro code values with `metro_codes` key. Example:<br><br>```<br>"location": {<br>  "country_codes": ["US", "CA"],<br>  "metro_codes": ["501", "602"]<br>}<br>```<br><br>For each ad group, specify at least one `GEO` or `LOCATION` code.<br><br>If you do not specify a `LOCATION` code, only `GEO` values will be targeted (See `GEO` parameter in this targeting spec.).<br><br>Learn how to [get a current, complete list of codes](/docs/analytics-and-reports/ads-reporting/#get-all-available-codes-and-zones).|
|LOCATION_EXCLUDE|[string]|false|none|[Closed beta](/docs/getting-started/using-beta-and-restricted-features/)<br><br>Metropolitan codes and/or ISO-Alpha-2, two-letter country codes to exclude from targeting.<br><br>See `LOCATION` parameter in this targeting spec for rules, syntax, and other information.|
|MAXIMUM_AGE|string|false|none|Maximum age to target (inclusive). Values: "18", "19", ..., "65", "65+". Must be used together with `MINIMUM_AGE`. Cannot be combined with `AGE_BUCKET`. If neither `MINIMUM_AGE`/`MAXIMUM_AGE` nor `AGE_BUCKET` are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|MINIMUM_AGE|string|false|none|Minimum age to target (inclusive). Values: "18", "19", ..., "65". Note: 65+ is not allowed for minimum age. Must be used together with `MAXIMUM_AGE`. Cannot be combined with `AGE_BUCKET`. If neither `MINIMUM_AGE`/`MAXIMUM_AGE` nor `AGE_BUCKET` are specified, all ages will be targeted.|
|SHOPPING_RETARGETING|[[TargetingSpecShoppingRetargeting](#schematargetingspecshoppingretargeting)]|false|none|Array of object: lookback_window [Integer]: Number of days ago to start lookback timeframe for dynamic retargeting tag_types [Array of integer]: Event types to target for dynamic retargeting exclusion_window [Integer]: Number of days ago to stop lookback timeframe for dynamic retargeting|
|TARGETING_STRATEGY|[[TargetingStrategy](#schematargetingstrategy)]|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|

|AGE_BUCKET|19+|

|AGE_BUCKET|21+|

For more information, see [Third-party and dynamic tracking](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/third-party-and-dynamic-tracking).|
